# [I'm not intimidated](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=191304980&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkxMzA0OTgwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzM3OTIyNzEsImV4cCI6MTc3NjM4NDI3MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pBLYJQsB1nh8QALPyyh8qyzgawfs_IcZ9VKlCoJYQvA)
### Michigan deserves a fighter who can win.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Mar 18
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..9UATfOHKNfCyLIQ_CYPR7lBRqCUgj9wUys369SxDYtk?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/im-not-intimidated?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Listen, the world can feel chaotic and confusing right now.
War. High gas prices. Unaffordable health care. Groceries that are way too expensive. Rising unemployment.
It feels like life is getting harder for regular folks while the wealthy and well-connected are doing better and better.
Honestly, it can be discouraging. I get it.
But through Donald Trump's cruelty and all the chaos in our country, here's what I want you to know:
I'm not intimidated. I'm not scared. And I'm more ready than ever to meet this moment.
Because I know two things for certain:
**I know how to fight for Michigan. I know how to deliver for Michigan.**
Look, this battleground Senate race is critical.
Michigan is going to decide a lot in 2026 - the balance of power in the Senate, accountability for Donald Trump, and whether working families have a proven fighter in their corner.
That's why I'm running.
And I know we can win. The polling has been clear:**[I'm the strongest Democrat in this race.](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0d86d3-b550-4f26-a4e5-5e18d1073b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I'm statistically tied with Republican Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate. I'm leading my Democratic opponents, poll after poll. And this is important: Polling consistently shows that among independent voters - _the people who will ultimately decide this race_ - I'm neck and neck with Rogers while both of my primary opponents are underwater.
This confirms what I've been hearing from voters on the ground: **Michiganders want results.**
They care less about the political party - they just want someone who listens to them, understands them, and can get things done for Michigan.
And they want someone who can win:
* I served as Chief of Staff on President Obama's auto rescue that helped **save 200,000 Michigan jobs** during the financial crisis.
* **I fought to bring semiconductor production** and advanced manufacturing back to Michigan.
* I introduced the **No Tariffs on Groceries Act** because families should not have to pay more at the checkout line for chaos in Washington.
* I stood up to **Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and introduced articles of impeachment** when he endangered public health and attacked science.
* I've spent my career fighting for working families, lower costs, and a stronger future for this state.

Republicans have made me their top target in this race since they _know_ I'm the biggest threat to their MAGA agenda.
That's why they're already dumping millions into this race - **including $5 million from a Texas oil billionaire backing Mike Rogers.**
_Fine._
**I 've been in hard fights before.** I know what it takes to stand up to billionaires and deliver results for working families.
Because here's the truth: Michiganders deserve more than a candidate who just shouts into a bullhorn.
They deserve someone who can win. Someone who will deliver results.
That's what I've spent my career doing.
**I 've never confused being flashy with being effective.**
I care more about whether Michigan families are better off. Whether workers have someone in their corner. Whether rural communities are being heard._Whether the government is actually helping the people it represents._
Michigan matters. The Senate majority matters. I'm ready to fight for both.
**[So if you're in a position to give, even a few dollars, it would mean a lot to me. Let's win this race, flip the Senate, and shut down Trump's agenda for good.](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0d86d3-b550-4f26-a4e5-5e18d1073b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0d86d3-b550-4f26-a4e5-5e18d1073b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0d86d3-b550-4f26-a4e5-5e18d1073b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127531270/608378453/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMxNzFhM2QzLTVlMjItZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cm5GaX8UOMV0r8yrTbXS45ZPMf77xdGyIL4RauQgCdY=&emci=c76a6943-1722-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=c171a3d3-5e22-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045)

Peter, no one should ever underestimate the power of a fired-up American citizenry. In fact, it’s what President Trump and his Republican allies fear the most right now. This relentless power grab hinges on bypassing democracy itself — silencing voters, bending the law, and hoping that no one can hold them accountable. They know that they don’t deserve the power they have. Their desperation is clear. And in the face of extreme actions and anti-democracy attacks, our institutions have failed us. The Executive Branch has failed us. Congress has failed us. The Supreme Court has failed us. **The only thing that’s going to save this nation — that’s going to save democracy as we know it — is the American people. An engaged, focused, committed American people.** And Peter, any student of history can tell you that when the American people take action together, we are a mighty force. No matter what the other side wants us to believe, **we still have that power. ** Saving democracy from those who want to break it isn’t something any of us thought we’d need to do, especially not in the year that our country celebrates its 250th birthday. But none of this is new. Every generation is faced with enormous, unprecedented, unfair attacks on their rights. It’s our turn. And I believe with my whole heart that our movement, our organizing, and our unity will prevail in the end. This shameful attack on democracy will fail. subject: When working people come together, anything is possible

body:
#
Just last week, Rep. Pat Ryan and I shared a beautiful day across New York.
We started with produce workers in The Bronx, bringing in apples from Ulster County. Then we went to Kingston and held a town hall in Glens Falls.
Because **when working people come together, anything is possible**.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260317-2.47SCyz&refcode=em20260317-10987-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10987%2E2526796%2EEqM5Tn)
Pa'lante,
Alexandria
We’re going to show that a politics of kindness, compassion, and ferocity in fighting for what’s right can help us win everywhere.
We’re hoping to hold more town halls soon but it takes major resources to put on events of this size across different states.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today to help us add more stops soon? | | **ICYMI: Senate Takes Up SAVE America Act as Experts Warn of Increased Voter Purges and Database Errors** The U.S. Senate is discussing the SAVE America Act today. This legislation would kick hundreds of thousands of eligible Americans off the voter rolls using the Department of Homeland Security’s SAVE database, known to have a history of data mismatches and incomplete records. If passed, this bill represents a major shift in how voter registration systems operate nationwide, likely triggering more aggressive voter roll maintenance, increasing the risk that eligible Americans are removed from the rolls, and raising concerns about how voter data shared with DHS could be used in immigration enforcement actions or wrongful prosecution. In close elections, even a few thousand wrongful removals can change the outcome. Trump knows that. **“The SAVE America Act is really the Voter Elimination Act.** It forces states to run their voter rolls through a DHS database that has been shown to mark citizens as non-citizens. This could create a system where flawed data and restrictive new documentation requirements lead to Americans being blocked from voting which is why Trump is so adamant that the Senate act. **He wants to pick and choose who gets to vote. This Voter Elimination Act is a nationwide purge machine and voter suppression on steroids.” **_—Lauren Groh-Wargo, CEO of Fair Fight Action_ We’ve been closely monitoring the SAVE America Act, and we will continue to do so as it is taken up in the Senate. Legislation like this — the kind that aims to make it harder, not easier, to vote — must be tracked closely. name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Leaked poll — the Epstein hit cuts her lead in half.
body:
Plus: He survived Iraq and Afghanistan. They let his shooter out early. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=43660dccaa&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
She flew on Jeffrey Epstein's plane. Six years after his conviction. Now she's running for governor of New Mexico — and even after voters find out, she's still the frontrunner. [We got a leaked poll](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d487b84774&e=567664f14c) that shows exactly how much it hurts Deb Haaland and why it's probably not enough to derail her campaign.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7f1df4f397&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔥 **LEAKED POLL — THE EPSTEIN HIT CUTS HER LEAD IN HALF**
Haaland starts this Democrat primary race up 34 points. Half the Democratic electorate doesn't even know who Bregman is. On paper, it's over before it starts.
Then the poll does something interesting. It tells voters she flew on Epstein's plane — six years after his conviction. 60% say that makes them less likely to support her. It tells them she won't debate because of it. 53% don't like that either.
Her lead drops from 34 to 15. Sounds like a race. Mark says it's fool's gold — and when you hear why, you'll understand how this thing ends.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=e62657dad5&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🚨 **HE SURVIVED IRAQ AND AFGHANISTAN. THEY LET THE SHOOTER OUT EARLY.**
Lt. Col. Brandon Shah flew combat helicopters. 600+ hours. Two Bronze Stars. He came home to Old Dominion University to train the next generation of officers.
A man convicted of helping ISIS — sentenced to 11 years — got out four years early. He walked into Shah's classroom, asked if it was ROTC, and opened fire. The students in that room rushed the gunman and stopped him. Their instructor didn't make it.

⛽ **TRUMP BOMBED KHARG ISLAND — LEFT THE OIL STANDING**
Trump hit military targets on the island that handles 90% of Iran's oil exports. He deliberately left the oil infrastructure intact.
Mark's take: that message is for China, not Iran. 87% of Iran's oil goes to China. If the oil goes, China's supply goes. Iran backed down within 24 hours and reopened the Strait. Meanwhile, every dollar increase in oil prices means $89 million more for New Mexico's budget.

✈️ **DHS SHUTDOWN — AVA'S 24-HOUR TRAVEL NIGHTMARE**
Democrats shut down DHS funding. TSA staffing collapsed. Ava tried to fly home from Virginia for spring break. She was supposed to be home by noon. She arrived at 3 AM the next day — after bouncing from Virginia to Indiana to Chicago back to Virginia to Albuquerque. Her texts to us at 3 AM are worth the episode alone.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8e34120bb7&e=567664f14c)
---
| |

That’s why they tremble when I have a microphone—not just in Minnesota...nationwide. | [ ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=0da19a20d5f541359d44dbbc064f9566&_e=BCDmcortC0NnRAYX2jjiOpclvrP9beQJNPHT76hCDctIIpEm7gpc-pVniPK93g613g4_rIS_eBvRKoUMybZSdAaJzN7N9PMYUyR2iMoI5Tk7iKGDLfCCtj30KIKgdwfg4YVeamBCxHxVfUGhO80u5CCXQwRsrkVIRrSCARU9CWQyV4BK8uOb0yynjjDA95Q6uQbgMUs6QsUs1CHSAvYI3KtkS2XPxehbv4Ip265FHETuN7DXHHYyvZ0z3qheAD75NkZI0lLyl9OmAIjfLY1RDNfA3iZJraJh3u2OibKaM2m3g_87MhAWUL68u27UZCAtEgB0WEOL3QRhAJ2RDk0uolrdcNY5QsdJejhC0UkMxF5SOmwCX3z7V0Ipv_3Ihbvs3q56K_1qH8VDDF18u5v-sl3McxHZ_v0isS2EsE0q_fOczUPoPUbd1jrobw83Boz_ltLRBnL3Me121penUTyulOKm3d_47kaoPabBlbkxC6HYn2ggOlWOm-Fi1L8VgRiP05EgLKG20SKZSR4F_nJLJ5wHhsz_57GntC80lEl1M96QGWPJv5FlR2WYaJg-NDOt)
---

Peter,

We’re just getting started.

The MNGOP endorsement is right around the corner.

And the real question is simple: _**Will Republicans choose courage, or will we have another Mitt Romney moment?**_

Another moment where the party panics, plays it safe, and nominates someone who’s “just right” for the consultants, the donors, and the political class.

That’s how you lose. My opponents know it.

That’s why they tremble when I have a microphone—not just in Minnesota...nationwide.

Because I don’t speak in the carefully scripted language of political consultants.

I just tell it like it is.

_Washington is broken.
The Establishment is corrupt.
And the Republican Party cannot keep nominating candidates who are afraid to say the truth out loud._

America doesn’t need another manager in the Senate.

[**America needs fighters.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=0da19a20d5f541359d44dbbc064f9566&_e=BCDmcortC0NnRAYX2jjiOpclvrP9beQJNPHT76hCDctIIpEm7gpc-pVniPK93g613g4_rIS_eBvRKoUMybZSdAaJzN7N9PMYUyR2iMoI5Tk7iKGDLfCCtj30KIKgdwfg4YVeamBCxHxVfUGhO80u5CCXQwRsrkVIRrSCARU9CWQyV4BK8uOb0yynjjDA95Q6m4tVoZco_LcKFPeQ3RH6PJ6gHql6aZXMvDlTgsRaTJMAAlNbfX1PaUnRtJbQnLaYz-EMtrlpdVucIYZXfpAIh2aFdkHv06qu54MnGAr9_A_uQfKi6p5qjueWc3diYMssbQjz74rREGQd4eXkJWwcIsPKq_2VZrBJ3b_foN9nvypLwiiYGMGKl7vI57-47gBlCXfhMGj3jQl6r2U6WYF3vFohuvK0sRqGre_G1KbArTrdFWKZid1VwkwpDiBjX5xWMGV1z3Uztq3Je_jfLvE6f7xD1QYjYfFqXz1tTXVR2Ww5HTuRXP1QB--T3ZqLefPjMzGXjobWwhwymip5zpom4GDQm4nZ1hAqoLil07AF9SmmUhGFtzdJIKeNaoUm1RG0)

I’m running to play for keeps. And in 2026, we’re going to win.

**But let me say something even more important.**

Too many people in politics today think we’re supposed to leave our faith at the door.

They say: _“Keep religion out of politics.”_

**No.**

We cannot walk away from faith while the country collapses around us.

**Politics without faith becomes tyranny.**

_There**is** right and wrong.
There **is** truth and untruth.

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.

Killed two amendments on the Senate floor today.
Four days ago, Meta sent the Idaho Senate a letter with three specific requests. And today two of those amendments showed up on the floor.
One bought Meta six more months before the bill takes effect. Six more months of doing exactly what this bill is supposed to stop. The other gutted the $10k private right of action, which is the only way parents can actually take Meta to court. Gone. (Because Meta asked for it).
HB 542 is already a bad bill ([I've written about why here](https://open.substack.com/pub/brianlenney/p/does-idaho-hb-542-replace-parents?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web)).
But taking marching orders from the biggest, most calculating purveyor of harm to kids on what Idaho legislation should say? And then delivering it four days later?
That's gross. There's no other word for it.
I'm here to protect kids. Not Facebook's bottom line.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🍀 Happy St. Patrick’s Day. 🍀Spring has sprung and so has allergy season in the Phoenix metro area. If you like to spend time outside, you know.We are on day 65 of this legislative session. Can you believe 2,121 House and Senate bills were introduced this year?For the past few weeks, during the week I have been busy meeting with constituents as well as small business owners and holding stakeholder meetings on addressing our state’s election security and a bill on social media online content for minors bills.Weekday work bleeds into weekends. For instance, last Saturday I participated on a panel called “Liberty Rising: So, you want to ... work in state or local government?” Law students were in Phoenix from around the country were actively engaged with this panel.Last week, my Senate Bill 1416 passed the Senate and was transmitted to the House. This bill focuses on the critical hours after a child goes missing or is abducted. Time matters when a child disappears. This legislation requires faster reporting to state and national databases, immediate coordination with the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, and timely public alerts through media and social platforms. It also strengthens training requirements, so law enforcement agencies are prepared to respond quickly and effectively.As you may know, I have worked on ways to strengthen Arizona’s fight against human trafficking since I served you in the House. We all know human trafficking continues to plague our communities. This bill was developed following my participation with the State Senate’s Human and Sex Trafficking Task Force over the summer, where law enforcement, prosecutors, survivors, and victim advocates shared firsthand insight into how Arizona can better protect vulnerable children and hold traffickers accountable.Both the Senate and House Republicans are working together on legislation to better protect Arizona children from online dangers. I have the honor of sponsoring Senate Bill 1747 with the goal to strengthen safeguards on digital platforms and websites. We all know technology continues to evolve and young children spend a lot of time online. The legislature is working on establishing new requirements for social media platforms and websites to help prevent kids from accessing harmful content and strengthen age-verification controls. These stronger protections and parental controls will help families navigate risks ranging from harmful content to exploitation.Arizona is not alone as other states across the country have been working diligently to pass similar measures. The legislation will require companies to implement reasonable age-verification measures before allowing users to create accounts, requires parental consent for younger minors to maintain social media accounts, and gives parents the ability to request termination of a child’s account and deletion of associated personal data from the platform.I believe parents deserve additional tools and transparency to help protect their children in an increasingly digital world. Protecting children from exploitation and harmful online content remains a top priority for Senate Republicans as technology continues to shape how young people interact with the world. My legislation now advances to the House for consideration and should be heard in the House Committee on Commerce next week.

## Gambling Leads Sports Revenue Sources
America is rushing this week to fill out March Madness gambling brackets, at a time when betting has overtaken all other categories to become [the single largest revenue segment](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk9jOiMzNpgULrahy7ZbIoOHMBtjI3sSlNuvslf46-_Te9L7c5_vniKlx29_oOMtzwmvGpEZy0zFp4g-YKlPihHD8YpMlf0MCgaptOzGOXiKn9k0wW2IgLpB11mrRxj74dbsbutX3HpjRt0H0LofYDPBrIsNJvTd6htyX5rS3dgpdQPb9tpq04Vt8fYGGFAYhYE4l_ZvpsQ7bvGT31jaNR9NdDvzWYX-JWASMF3X1b6pvnxc_UnsI1X-HgVM9RQwMRYFcinon5QeMuQrSd5Rms7KhWKknGQ9c-EqKYVX5fIRMDXFhfP6znWwwqjH4Sn-9_OPor0d_AsAAP__iFaCww) in the $417 billion global sports industry, accounting for $133 billion, nearly one-third of the total market. Media rights and related broadcast revenues form the industry's second major pillar, with rights deals alone worth $61 billion and pay-TV subscriptions adding another $49 billion. Sponsorship and in-venue advertising contribute $52 billion, while live match-day revenues from tickets and hospitality bring in $34 billion, underscoring the enduring value of live fan experiences. The industry shows no signs of slowing, with projections placing total market value at $602 billion by 2030, fueled by mobile wagering platforms and the ongoing shift toward digital streaming. body:
I’m feeling a little sentimental and wanted to share some pictures with you!!!

| | | | I’m coming to you as a Navy Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, GOP Congresswoman, but most importantly as a MOM.
I was looking through some old photos recently and wanted to share a few with you. They help tell my story, but also explain why I’m the Democrats #1 target in the upcoming midterm elections!![](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/adaXilcPXoE6uLefwTu5rA)That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I’m a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. As the granddaughter of a veteran, daughter of a veteran, spouse of a veteran, and mother of future veterans, I come from a PROUD military family.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/TQTMPs2NEsdK56nzKenuYA)I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - “Blossom.” I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/lcRgyveBnBLK4j0UG7Aegw)After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.
Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I’m not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.
So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/WpYcMstXHagnbBDoZhw_fQ)I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.
Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.
So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. So I ran for Congress! [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/H7ng6b0g_GfdCmll6CH-AQ)When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that’s what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent’s campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me. But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation. [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/9KYkzlWe8qEl4G7g2ohxTA)And in Congress, we’ve been able to make a big impact. I’m leading the charge to lower prices, cut taxes, get better care for our veterans, support military families, and secure the border. We’re making good progress, but all our progress could be in jeopardy if we lose in the upcoming elections.
See, that same Democrat I defeated in 2022 is back for revenge. She just announced her campaign against me, and she raised over $500,000 from Democrat activists in just a few days. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets, and they are already spending big on attack ads.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/Bw5FxSptLTIvf02N7hVeFg)If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?
I can’t stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!
Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTAzLzE3LzIwMjYgNTowMjowOSAoY29weSBvZikgVGVzdF8yMDI2MDMxOF9BVy1GMy4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NDczNTctMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MDMvMTcvMjAyNiA1OjAyOjA5IChjb3B5IG9mKSBUZXN0XzIwMjYwMzE4X0FXLUYzLjExMDExN190MTg0NzM1Ny0yMDY4In0/Bi5_ps0rS7OYvFr8MED9Mg)-Jen[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success! [SUPPORT JEN KIGGANS
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)| | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress

Ah yes, the Academy, in its infinite wisdom, has once again proven that nothing quite says "we respect cinema" like a bureaucratic checklist that would make the DMV weep with envy. The 98th Academy Awards have arrived, and with them, the full enforcement of those delightful "Representation and Inclusion Standards" that essentially require Best Picture contenders to submit their films like college applications--complete with diversity essays and proof they've hired enough people from "underrepresented groups" to satisfy the Academy's newly minted social justice calculus.

Congratulations to the winners; 'One Battle After Another' for Best Picture; Jessie Buckley and Michael B. Jordan for acting. Sean Penn won his third Oscar for best supporting actor, but skipped the ceremony...to visit Ukraine.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.hbe4-xdw0HFmErGDRsvBPLrDW0rA6O89FWlx0ETniJk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=191290430)
Isn't it wonderful? To win Best Picture, a film must now satisfy at least two of four standards concerning on-screen representation, creative leadership, crew composition, or industry access. You know, because the quality of the filmmaking itself was apparently too simple a criterion. Why judge a movie by its artistic merit when you can judge it by whether the key grip identifies as part of a marginalized community?

Take poor 'The Godfather' (1972). Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, Robert Duvall--these problematic individuals are all, gasp, white men telling a story about an Italian-American crime family. Where are the LGBTQ+ narrative themes? The female department heads? The underrepresented racial groups in significant roles? Francis Ford Coppola's masterpiece would be laughed out of the room today. "Sorry, Francis, but your film about toxic masculinity and the corruption of the American dream doesn't meet our inclusion metrics. No Best Picture nomination for you. Have you considered adding a transgender consigliere?"

'The Godfather Part II' (1974) fares no better. Sure, it deals with immigration and features Italian-American actors, but the Academy's new standards demand representation across multiple underrepresented groups. Italian-Americans, despite being historically discriminated against, apparently don't check the right boxes in 2026. The film focuses on, you know, "men"--predominantly white ones. And the crew? Forget it. This was the 1970s; the concept of "equity in below-the-line positions" was about as common as a smartphone.

'Unforgiven' (1992)? Clint Eastwood's deconstruction of Western mythology? A film about aging white outlaws in the 1880s frontier? The Academy would need smelling salts. No people of color in lead roles. No LGBTQ+ themes. Sorry, no Brokeback Mountain. No women in key creative positions (unless you count costume design, which the Academy barely does). The film's exhaustive portrayal of white male violence would be deemed "insufficiently representative." Sorry, Clint--perhaps if you'd made Will Munny a queer Black woman seeking revenge against systemic oppression, you might have had a shot. Wait you say, what about Ned Logan? No nomination for Morgan Freeman that year.

'Casablanca' (1942)? Set in Morocco during WWII, featuring predominantly white European refugees played by, you guessed it, white actors? The Academy would have an aneurysm. Dooley Wilson plays Sam magnificently, but one Black supporting character does not diversity standards make. Plus, the film was directed by Michael Curtiz, a Hungarian Jewish immigrant--but that doesn't count because he's still a white man. The representation math simply doesn't add up.

And 'Titanic' (1997), that landmark film that drew 55 million viewers to the Oscars, a record not yet topped, when it won? The very movie that made the Academy Awards must-see television? Well, let's see: two white leads in a romance, a white director, a predominantly white upper-class victim pool in first class, and--worst of all--a focus on "historical accuracy" rather than contemporary ideological checkboxes. Kate Winslet and Leonardo DiCaprio playing fictional white characters on a real ship full of actual historical white people? That's not "inclusive storytelling," that's "problematic perpetuation of dominant narratives." James Cameron would need to reshoot the sinking scene to include at least three differently-abled non-binary people of color among the drowning passengers to even be considered.

Which brings us to the delightful reality of Oscar viewership. Remember when 55 million people tuned in to see 'Titanic' sweep the awards in 1998? Those were the days--when people actually cared about movies, when films were events, when Best Picture winners were cultural touchstones rather than homework assignments. Fast forward to 2025, when a mere 18 million viewers bothered to watch. That's right--down from 55 million to 18 million. A two-thirds drop in audience. Bravo, Academy! Truly, these inclusion standards are bringing the people together!

Because here's what the Academy doesn't understand: when you turn art into activism, when you prioritize political checklists over storytelling, when you nominate films that critics love but audiences ignore, you become irrelevant. The average American doesn't want to watch a ceremony celebrating movies they've never heard of, made according to bureaucratic formulas rather than artistic inspiration. They want to see *their* movies celebrated--films that moved them, entertained them, became part of their lives.

But the Academy soldiers on, convinced that the problem isn't their own self-imposed irrelevance, but rather that audiences are simply too unenlightened to appreciate cinema that checks the right demographic boxes. The solution, clearly, is more standards! More rules! More forced diversity requirements that make films feel like corporate DEI seminars rather than art!

Keep it up, Academy. At this rate, by the 108th Academy Awards in 2036, you'll be broadcasting to an audience of twelve sociology professors and a diversity consultant. But hey, at least your Best Picture nominees will have met all four representation standards. Artistic merit is so overrated anyway.

Here are some prior Best Picture winners and how these classics might fare against modern Academy inclusion standards:

**No Country for Old Men** - Fails the on-screen representation test because the only Spanish-speaking characters are corpses or Javier Bardem with a pageboy haircut. The Academy now requires at least one woman to have a conversation about something other than cattle gun murders.

**The Departed** - Martin Scorsese's Boston crime epic features 47 white guys from Southie and Vera Farmiga accidentally dating both of them. Fails the " Not Every Character Named Sean or Patrick" provision.

**Chicago** - Despite Queen Latifah's presence as Matron Mama Morton, the film fails the behind-the-camera standards because apparently "jazz hands" doesn't count as a historically underrepresented group in department heads.

**A Beautiful Mind** - Russell Crowe's mathematician hallucinates roommates but somehow still hallucinates only white guys. Academy notes: "Even the imaginary friends lack diversity."

**Gladiator** - DreamWorks spent $100 million recreating ancient Rome using only actors from the Home Counties of England. The only German in the film is the Emperor, and he's the villain. No wonder the electorate misspelled "Joaquin" on their ballots.

**Braveheart** - Mel Gibson's historical accuracy about 13th-century Scotland is questionable (the kilts alone), but what's undeniable is that every single person in this film is the same shade of woad blue. Catherine McCormack literally exists just to die and motivate William Wallace, which violates the "Women Should Have Plot Functions Beyond Being Murdered Props" bylaw.

**Titanic** - The steerage deck technically passes the on-screen diversity check, but the film fails because Billy Zane's character represents Hollywood's historically overrepresented demographic: "guys who own comically large spatulas." A 1910s equivalent of a tech bro.

**Forrest Gump** - Features exactly one significant Black character (Bubba), who dies so that Forrest can start a shrimp company in his honor. The Academy now requires that Black characters survive long enough to receive profit-sharing.

**Schindler's List** - While understandably limited in casting options given the subject matter, Steven Spielberg's Holocaust drama fails the "Light and Joy" appendix of the new standards. Academy note: "We said representation, not film representation of systemic genocide."

**Unforgiven** - Clint Eastwood's revisionist western features 11 characters, 10 of whom are grizzled white men who look like they smoke their own beard hair. Gene Hackman's character fails the "Antagonists Should Have Non-Violent Conflict Resolution Training" requirement.

**Amadeus** - Tom Hulce plays Mozart as a giggling menace in 18th-century Vienna, featuring zero composers of color and zero women who aren't either his wife or a masked figure at a party. The Academy specifically cites "Insufficient Salieri apology tours."

**Patton** - George C. Scott's WWII biopic fails because it suggests that winning Golden Globes requires even less diversity than winning Oscars--namely, just one general and two tanks.

**The Sound of Music** - Despite being about a family that literally hides in a convent to escape Nazis, the film fails the "Awards Season Should Not Require Nuns" standard. Julie Andrews represents 90% of the film's female speaking roles, which violates the "Maria Distribution" clause.

**My Fair Lady** - Audrey Hepburn plays a Cockney flower seller while being Audrey Hepburn, which violates the "Casting Should Match Geography" rule. The film also fails because Rex Harrison talks-sings his way through approximately 400 songs while Eliza waits for him to finish.

**Casablanca** - Almost passes thanks to Dooley Wilson's Sam, but fails the "Round of Applause for Dooley Wilson" standard when the Academy realized he wasn't even allowed to play piano in the recording session due to segregation. The new rules retroactively require Bogart to say "Here's looking at all of you, representing various historically underrepresented groups" instead.

**Ben-Hur** - Charlton Heston, an American, plays a Judean prince; Stephen Boyd, an Irishman, plays a Roman; and Jack Hawkins, an Englishman, plays Quintus Arrius. It only technically passes the Middle Eastern representation requirement because the entire region is portrayed by Community Theater Shakespeares from Connecticut.

**Gone with the Wind** - If this film were somehow submitted today, it wouldn't be rejected--it would be subpoenaed.
These films collectively represent Hollywood's golden age of "White Men Doing Things: A Catalog." Under the new standards, the only category they'd sweep is "Best Picture for Making Modern Audiences Say 'Yikes' During Rewatches."

Titanic - The steerage deck technically passes the on-screen diversity check, but the film fails because Billy Zane's character represents Hollywood's historically overrepresented demographic: "guys who own comically large spatulas." A 1910s equivalent of a tech bro. Forrest Gump - Features exactly one significant Black character (Bubba), who dies so that Forrest can start a shrimp company in his honor. The Academy now requires that Black characters survive long enough to receive profit-sharing. Schindler's List - While understandably limited in casting options given the subject matter, Steven Spielberg's Holocaust drama fails the "Light and Joy" appendix of the new standards. Academy note: "We said representation, not film representation of systemic genocide." Unforgiven - Clint Eastwood's revisionist western features 11 characters, 10 of whom are grizzled white men who look like they smoke their own beard hair. Gene Hackman's character fails the "Antagonists Should Have Non-Violent Conflict Resolution Training" requirement. Amadeus - Tom Hulce plays Mozart as a giggling menace in 18th-century Vienna, featuring zero composers of color and zero women who aren't either his wife or a masked figure at a party. The Academy specifically cites "Insufficient Salieri apology tours." Patton - George C. Scott's WWII biopic fails because it suggests that winning Golden Globes requires even less diversity than winning Oscars--namely, just one general and two tanks. The Sound of Music - Despite being about a family that literally hides in a convent to escape Nazis, the film fails the "Awards Season Should Not Require Nuns" standard. Julie Andrews represents 90% of the film's female speaking roles, which violates the "Maria Distribution" clause. My Fair Lady - Audrey Hepburn plays a Cockney flower seller while being Audrey Hepburn, which violates the "Casting Should Match Geography" rule. The film also fails because Rex Harrison talks-sings his way through approximately 400 songs while Eliza waits for him to finish. Casablanca - Almost passes thanks to Dooley Wilson's Sam, but fails the "Round of Applause for Dooley Wilson" standard when the Academy realized he wasn't even allowed to play piano in the recording session due to segregation. The new rules retroactively require Bogart to say "Here's looking at all of you, representing various historically underrepresented groups" instead. Ben-Hur - Charlton Heston, an American, plays a Judean prince; Stephen Boyd, an Irishman, plays a Roman; and Jack Hawkins, an Englishman, plays Quintus Arrius. It only technically passes the Middle Eastern representation requirement because the entire region is portrayed by Community Theater Shakespeares from Connecticut. Gone with the Wind - If this film were somehow submitted today, it wouldn't be rejected--it would be subpoenaed. These films collectively represent Hollywood's golden age of "White Men Doing Things: A Catalog." Under the new standards, the only category they'd sweep is "Best Picture for Making Modern Audiences Say 'Yikes' During Rewatches." Sacrifice comes with a cost
| Dear Friend,
---
When offered a taxpayer-funded pension for serving as Mayor of the largest city in America, I said **_“NO!”_**
---
Much like President Trump who refuses a presidential salary, I view the position of Mayor as _public_ service – not some get-rich, self-serving scheme like Nancy Pelosi and the Biden Crime Family.
---
Today that pension would help me pay my legal bills to stay out of jail as an innocent man! It would cover basic living expenses after I was forced to sell my home.
---
But nevertheless, I did the _right_ thing. _Service to the American public trumps service to self_.
---

---
**_Now, I want to make myself absolutely clear, which is why I am putting this line in bold AND underlining it!_**
---
I don’t want you to feel even an _ounce_ of guilt to donate. If you cannot give, please don’t think twice. Sacrifice comes with a cost, and I knew full well the consequences of refusing a pension.
---
And the truth is: _I will find a way_. My entire life has been about finding a way. They said I couldn’t clean up New York, take down the Mafia, and help President Trump get justice – and yet, _I did!_
---
3 years ago, I was named Prisoner # **_01135780_** in the most violent jail in America alongside my friend and former client.

clean_body: Sacrifice comes with a cost Sacrifice comes with a cost | Dear Friend, When offered a taxpayer-funded pension for serving as Mayor of the largest city in America, I said “NO!” Much like President Trump who refuses a presidential salary, I view the position of Mayor as public service – not some get-rich, self-serving scheme like Nancy Pelosi and the Biden Crime Family. Today that pension would help me pay my legal bills to stay out of jail as an innocent man! It would cover basic living expenses after I was forced to sell my home. But nevertheless, I did the right thing. Service to the American public trumps service to self. Having been pushed to the brink of BANKRUPTCY and ROBBED of my law licenses so that I can’t even defend myself, my only hope to stay out of prison until I’m 101 years old is to retain a top-notch legal defense team that will BEAT the bloodthirsty Democrat lawyers in court. That won’t be cheap! Now, I want to make myself absolutely clear, which is why I am putting this line in bold AND underlining it! I don’t want you to feel even an ounce of guilt to donate. If you cannot give, please don’t think twice. Sacrifice comes with a cost, and I knew full well the consequences of refusing a pension. And the truth is: I will find a way. My entire life has been about finding a way. They said I couldn’t clean up New York, take down the Mafia, and help President Trump get justice – and yet, I did! 3 years ago, I was named Prisoner # 01135780 in the most violent jail in America alongside my friend and former client. Think about how much has changed! Now, I’ve got a fighting chance for FREEDOM. Thank you and God bless you, Rudy Giuliani Rudy Defense Trust Paid for by Rudy Defense Trust Pop Acta Media | Conservative Innovation PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

## Cornyn, Casar Clash at Austin Airport
Sen. John Cornyn and U.S. Rep. Greg Casar (D-Austin) got into a [heated exchange](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuupDAQRL8GMiM_WB6Bg03I7qYboh53Gyx5aNT2HWb-fsX-wo1Lqqpz_n6tX5ByOrY_8CRf35HXg66SqVaSVRiJUaiUwEgPFiTJcJXv1Wo7KO2UmVaElD9r36J_aJxNS96Mo5vcaKa-3f0Y-mGY7QzODEHHGOBXiBoJLfWG4tgmf5dpZyZjndOumx0MONrZ9sYND4pNrwlTZenqTpXeUGL-8IukC_xss99rPUvjfjd2aexyXVcX-X1T3Hljl5NzqimUxi6B5fgcKmQoOxV1Cm83XXqREjrVJrSpAAVE7QSVUEGSk6WqCIEUx6juXYV7UWX_rsjX0YrH80o5pzKMTa-3J6T8_1n9mc-Xt_8CAAD__3zpjus) Monday at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport over funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and TSA. Peter,
Republicans are rebranding their messaging to voters in a last-ditch attempt to distance themselves from Trump's unpopular agenda.
But they endorsed the ugliest parts of Trump's promise of "mass deportation."
They funded ICE to the tune of $170 billion and gave a group of untrained white supremacists carte blanche to shoot, maim, kill, and violate our Constitutional rights.
They supported abductions and deportations without due process.
And they fell in line and repeated Trump and his vile henchman Stephen Miller's lies and attempts to assassinate the character of two U.S. citizens who were murdered by ICE in the streets of Minnesota.
Now with the Latino vote turning against them in every single election held since 2024, congressional Republicans are trying to walk away from all of that -- and rebranding their pathetic flip-flop as a "course correction."

This is exactly why red state GOP leaders are redoubling their efforts to rig the maps ahead of the midterm election so they can weather the blue wave that will crush them in November.
They know the only way they can survive the reckoning headed toward them is to gerrymander as many districts as possible to pack in thousands of MAGA diehard voters into every competitive district.
But we anticipated this move: our ballot measure to redraw Colorado's congressional map would flip three GOP-held red seats in blue state Colorado, providing a critical backstop to ensure Republicans are held accountable for the damage they've done to our country.

| Peter,
This is a full-blown EMERGENCY.
MAGA is moving fast to rig the upcoming elections. If Trump succeeds, our Republic could collapse before our very eyes.
And MAGA has unveiled the most dangerous piece of their election rigging strategy yet in Congress. It's called the SAVE Act:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019VkndkzE0UoHWOhLtgajFi0TMsyM_oLEXY34K7kt60-cswioe03H8H0kbYaAoOzjQHmIBjLfpFrW1oep3-rhd2xbHHtdoYZvfpQ-mHn4K5PGJiMrJX2r3zeoDeui3F6VVHGyxLY7iUYrL0MZFxru4abPiW2ZvhR5Vz4fIKaOnN8tWx6BmsoAxTpx7oJZYrUKe6isYgfkZaCD75oUpxqRW7ssKN4IQpgQ-S_XfI831Og=&c=-4_bCgWfcFhEwISqNgA-GLC4g5lKlVYxZgs9SXx8580F5sxnTKyoIg==&ch=9fs1HnzsYei2zwHnSM6t9UD8Z0NdldQVeWhyqO1gvs_Ka1aFsKEgOg==)
---
MAGA just introduced their equivalent of the Death Star, and it could destroy our Republic.
The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of voters. In some states, it could end mail-in voting. It would also open the door to intimidating election workers with threats of prosecution
Right now, MAGA Senate Majority Leader John Thune is pledging to bring the SAVE Act to the Senate floor. MAGA Speaker Mike Johnson has already pushed it through the House.
But Democrats aren't without hope: There is one critical flaw in their plan. Election administration is a state responsibility, and state Supreme Courts will play a decisive role in how any federal voting law is interpreted and enforced.
That's why Defend Our Courts exists. In 2025, we successfully defended the pro-democracy majority on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court to safeguard election integrity in a critical swing state.
Now, MAGA billionaires are gearing up to spend millions to try and capture state Supreme Courts to advance Trump's election rigging plot in 2026. It will be an uphill battle.
But we have friends everywhere.
With over 100,000 grassroots donors nationwide, we are one of the largest forces leading the rebellion against MAGA's election rigging plot. That's why we are gearing up to take the fight against MAGA nationwide.
If you believe elections should be decided by voters, not intimidation, manipulation, or bad-faith laws, we need you to join our cause:

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. [](https://substack.com/redirect/02674a7f-5eb0-4758-970c-9a8fd72ce161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Liberty is the road we travel. Not the destination.
That's why I vote conservative instead of libertarian even though I agree with libertarians probably 60% (ish) of the time and genuinely like a lot of them personally, especially here in Idaho.
But here's where I get off the highway.
The Big L Libertarian position on drugs is that legalization is the only logically consistent liberty position. And look, I understand the argument. But we don't live in a philosophy seminar. We live in a community where meth destroyed entire family lines, where fentanyl is killing kids who thought they were taking a Xanax, and where the social wreckage of that stuff lands on neighbors, churches, grandparents raising grandchildren because their own kids are gone.
"Personal choice" sounds clean until you're watching what's left of a family at a funeral for a 24 year old. Liberty without cultural guardrails doesn't set you free. It just moves the chaos somewhere else, usually onto the people least able to handle it, while the guy tweeting about the non-aggression principle never has to clean it up.
Smae with hookers. Consenting adults, victimless (they say). Except it's not victimless. The communities where that gets normalized don't get more free, they get coarser, more predatory, and harder on women and kids downstream. I'm not interested in optimizing for theoretical adult autonomy at the expense of what that does to the culture my kids grow up in.
Open borders is where they completely lose me and frankly, most Americans. Open borders is the logical endpoint of pure liberty philosophy. "Labor should flow freely like capital." Except I'm not trying to optimize a global labor market. I live in a country with a particular history and particular people already in it who I actually owe something to. You can't conserve anything with open borders. You just get demographic replacement and call it freedom.
And that word, conserve, that's the whole point.
I'm a conservative. The job is to conserve things worth keeping. The family. The kids. The place you actually live. Liberty is a powerful tool for doing that. Limited government, free markets, personal responsibility.
_**But all of it only matters if there 's something worth protecting on the other end.**_
And when 'muh liberty' is the answer to everything, including whether your community gets any say in what takes root inside it? Brother, you left conservatism about three exits back.
A lot of my libertarian-leaning friends here in Idaho get this instinctively even if they don't frame it this way. They want liberty because they want to be left alone to raise their families, run their farms, live by their values. The liberty is in service of something. They're not philosophically committed to a world where anything goes as long as nobody technically coerces anybody.
That's the small L libertarian I can work with.
The Big L who follows the philosophy all the way to its logical endpoint, wherever that leads, open borders, legal everything, zero community standards because standards are coercion? That person is consistent. I'll give them that. They're just following the road all the way to the end.
I got off twenty miles back because there was actually somewhere I was trying to go.

And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.

I have some exciting news:
Hi there, it’s Elizabeth Warren. I’ve spent my career looking for fighters.
Not just candidates who check the right boxes. Real fighters — people who are unafraid to take a stand and who don’t flinch when the fight gets tough.
So today, I’m proud to endorse Mallory McMorrow for U.S. Senate in Michigan — and I’m asking you to join me in supporting this fighter.
[**Will you make a donation of $28 or anything you can to support Mallory’s campaign right now? This race is going to be won on the ground — and Mallory needs your help to build it.**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/1827?refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_VIP_AC_20260318_AM1_V1_S1&t=1&akid=4241%2E898137%2EPrSTRm)

I remember first calling Mallory after she flipped a Republican-held seat in 2018. I was immediately inspired by her ideas, her plans, and her fight to make a real difference.
In the Michigan Senate, Mallory didn’t waste any time playing it safe after she won. She used her power to help end Michigan’s 1931 abortion ban. She fought to raise wages. She cut taxes for working families and seniors.
And now she’s running to take that fight to the U.S. Senate — to advocate for even more transformational changes for working families in Michigan and across the country.
Mallory is running on paid family leave, affordable childcare, a real minimum wage — the things that actually change people’s lives. And unlike so many politicians who make those promises and disappear, she knows how to fight and how to deliver.
And she’s building her campaign the right way: Not with corporate PAC money, not with billionaire donors, but with grassroots supporters.
Mallory is the partner — and the true fighter — I need by my side in the Senate to make our government work for working people. But she can only get there with your help.

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Kat narrowly lost — but so did AIPAC.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Bad news: Justice Democrats-endorsed Kat Abughazaleh narrowly lost to
Evanston Mayor Daniel Biss in a crowded open primary with sixteen
candidates in Illinois’ 9th congressional district.

Good news: AIPAC’s candidate lost, too.

The Israel lobby group spent over $7 million in this race boosting Laura
Fine and attacking Kat in the final week through two different shell PACs:
Elect Chicago Women PAC and Chicago Progressive Partnership. Two Super
PACs named intentionally to obscure AIPAC’s funding.

Despite spending more than anyone in the race, AIPAC lost resoundingly,
failing in their brash attempt to buy every open seat in Illinois this
cycle. In contrast, Kat ran a historic grassroots campaign, raising $4
million from over 67,000 donors.

Her campaign was an inspiration to millions of young people and people
disillusioned with our political system, reminding them that they do
deserve better from their leaders.

Her goal, win or lose, was to ensure this campaign would have a direct
positive impact on the community in IL-09. She turned her campaign office
into a mutual aid hub that collects and distributes toiletries, hygiene
products, clothes, books, bags, sanitation supplies, NARCAN, diapers,
food, and more.

Though Kat narrowly lost this race, we are proud to have backed this
campaign that helped ensure the people of IL-09 would not be represented
by another AIPAC shill.

This outcome is a massive loss for AIPAC as they lose more and more
influence within the Democratic Party. No amount of shell PACs or covert
funding can hide their toxicity from Democratic voters — their monopoly
over this Party’s agenda is coming to an end.

President Trump **[put NATO allies on notice](https://substack.com/redirect/4fd6e20a-2fd2-46b7-aaa1-a58444424547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday after they refused his request for military assistance to keep the Strait of Hormuz open for international shipping, publicly lashing out at European allies including France and the UK.
When asked if he would remove the United States from NATO, Trump told reporters "it's certainly something that we should think about" and emphasized "I don't need Congress for that decision, as you probably know, I can make that decision myself."
## [Watch Trump's fiery message to the press here:](https://substack.com/redirect/4fd6e20a-2fd2-46b7-aaa1-a58444424547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4fd6e20a-2fd2-46b7-aaa1-a58444424547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/4fd6e20a-2fd2-46b7-aaa1-a58444424547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The president expressed deep disappointment with the alliance, complaining that "we spend trillions of dollars on NATO" and citing it as "one of the reasons we have deficits," while noting the US is the largest financial contributor at approximately $980 billion in 2025, accounting for 65% of NATO's defense budget.
Trump had been seeking minesweepers and destroyers from European countries to keep the strait open for oil transport but received a resounding no.
In a lengthy Truth Social post, he wrote "the United States has been informed by most of our NATO 'Allies' that they don't want to get involved with our Military Operation" and noted "we will protect them, but they will do nothing for us, in particular, in a time of need." # **Far-left influencer Kat Abughazaleh loses crowded Illinois House primary to replace retiring Rep. Jan Schakowsky**
Far-left social media influencer and former Media Matters journalist Kat Abughazaleh, 26, **[lost her bid to replace retiring Rep. Jan Schakowsky in Illinois' 9th Congressional District,](https://substack.com/redirect/e1f599ff-b4ab-4ef5-b41a-d8f5256cfffb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** losing to Daniel Biss, mayor of Evanston and former state lawmaker, in a 15-candidate primary. Abughazaleh's campaign website touted "a new type of Democratic campaign," warning "if you're a right-wing billionaire or a member of the Democratic consultant class, this campaign isn't for you."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b356b9d9-dd7c-4a9b-a428-dd0af164366a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Abughazaleh notably said during a primary debate she did not support House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries' continued leadership and was indicted on federal charges late last year related to an incident where agitators allegedly attacked an ICE vehicle outside a Chicago suburb holding facility. Biss was the only candidate backed by Schakowsky, while State Sen. Laura Fine, the most moderate frontrunner, was supported by AIPAC-linked groups and said she would back Jeffries.
* **The race:** The 9th District includes part of Chicago and northern suburbs and is rated D+19 by Cook Political Report, making the primary winner all but assured to win November's general election. Biss previously ran for Illinois governor but lost his primary to current Gov. JB Pritzker before becoming Evanston's mayor.

# **White House sends new DHS counteroffer to Senate after 18-day standoff, promises body cameras and limits on enforcement at sensitive locations**
The White House sent a DHS **[counteroffer to Sens. Katie Britt and Susan Collins on Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/ac13e601-c495-46a0-8e83-fd0ef1a6ce50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Democrats sent their own Monday night, promising to "expand the use of body-worn cameras," "limit civil immigration enforcement activities at certain sensitive locations" with exceptions, increase detention oversight, and "enforce the use of visible officer identification" for non-undercover officers. A senior White House official said "this offer is reasonable, it is serious," though Democrats are demanding major changes including ending agent masking and requiring judicial warrants.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ac13e601-c495-46a0-8e83-fd0ef1a6ce50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The shutdown started mid-February over immigration enforcement tactics after Operation Metro Surge in Minnesota, including Alex Pretti's shooting death, with impacts rippling nationwide--notably long TSA lines as agents call out or quit while working without pay, plus mounting national security concerns amid Operation Epic Fury in Iran. Democrats argue Republicans are blocking funding for TSA, FEMA, and Coast Guard without reopening DHS, with Sen. Patty Murray saying "Republicans are holding TSA agents' paychecks hostage because they want to provide more money to ICE, without basic reforms."

* **The divide:** Sen. John Fetterman is the only Democrat against the shutdown, noting ICE and CBP funding was already secured in the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act," though he backs enforcement reforms. Britt's office said Democrats have been uncooperative despite most Trump immigration priorities already funded.

# **ICE seeks to detain illegal immigrant accused of using video game currency to lure children after sanctuary state let him loose**
DHS and ICE **[issued an arrest detainer for Mexican illegal immigrant](https://substack.com/redirect/997f195d-d171-4112-8bff-3294c25f94e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Angel David Rubio Marin, who allegedly used "Robux," the Roblox video game currency, to entice at least three children under 10 to send sexually explicit videos and images. He was previously arrested for two counts of public masturbation but was released in Virginia prior to the current charges, prompting Acting Assistant Secretary Lauren Bis to say "This case is a perfect example of why we need state and local cooperation with ICE."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/997f195d-d171-4112-8bff-3294c25f94e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Angel David Rubio Marin charged with soliciting sexual content from children and was previously charged with two counts of public masturbation.
* **Why it matters:** The case highlights criticism of Virginia's sanctuary-style policies under Democratic Governor Abigail Spanberger, who ended the 287(g) program and state cooperation with ICE in February through an executive directive shortly after her inauguration. The directive reversed former Republican Gov. Glenn Youngkin's policy that allowed local law enforcement to carry out limited immigration enforcement responsibilities under ICE supervision, including ensuring criminal illegal migrants were not released back into communities.
* **What they 're saying:** Bis called on "Virginia sanctuary politicians and Governor Spanberger to commit to not releasing this child predator back into Virginia neighborhoods," adding "no one wants this pedophile loose on American streets." Spanberger defended her directive by arguing that requiring state and local officers to take on federal immigration duties "diverts them from their primary responsibilities of enforcing Virginia law" and "can damage relationships between police and residents and create an atmosphere of fear and mistrust." Roblox clarified that the platform's filters make it impossible for users to share images or videos through in-game chat.

# **Belgium deploys military to protect Jewish sites after synagogue explosion in Li ege**
Belgium **[deployed military personnel Monday to protect Jewish sites](https://substack.com/redirect/04d7d934-fee4-45ec-a8e3-f269007245b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** across the country following a pre-dawn explosion at a Liege synagogue on March 9 that shattered windows on nearby buildings but caused no injuries. The Ministry of Defence, coordinating with federal police, will oversee security at synagogues, Jewish schools, and other Jewish community locations, with Defence Minister Theo Francken writing "the safety of every citizen must be guaranteed" and vowing "antisemitism and hatred against Jews will never be tolerated."
* **What happened:** Prime Minister Bart De Wever called the blast "an attack on our values and our society" and pledged to fight antisemitism across Belgium, while Liege Mayor Willy Demeyer condemned it as an antisemitic act and warned against "importing foreign conflicts into the city." Interior Minister Bernard Quintin called the attack "despicable" and said authorities would expand security measures around similar sites.
* **The response:** Georges-Louis Bouchez, leader of the center-right Mouvement Reformateur party, and Antwerp Mayor Els Van Doesburg publicly called for armed security following the blast, while the Coordinating Committee of Jewish Organisations in Belgium urged a visible military presence. The deployment happened immediately under Article 111 of the Integrated Police Act, which allows the federal police commissioner general to request military support.

It wasn’t easy
| Friend, I didn’t make this decision lightly. When I announced my campaign for governor of Wisconsin, I did it because I saw how much our working families were struggling – and what would be at stake if a Republican was elected to lead this state. _Healthcare costs are skyrocketing because Republicans voted against extending subsidies._ _Our family farms and small businesses are feeling the squeeze due to the Trump-Tiffany economic plan._ _And when Republicans care more about lining the pockets of their billionaire backers, working families lose out on affordable housing and groceries._ **That’s why I jumped into this race — because Wisconsinites deserve a state where they can thrive, not just scrape by paycheck to paycheck.** [If you agree with me, you can use this link to make a contribution of any amount to power our campaign.](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-mar26.Ye988L&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_031826_B1_MyDecisionRE&t=2&akid=5935%2E196590%2EtRXDkb)** **Tiffany will bring the rampant dysfunction and far-right extremism of Washington here to Wisconsin.** Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we’ve built a movement that is ready to do things the Wisconsin Way, not the Washington Way. | | Hi, This is Brigadier General James Emory Mace, U.S. Army (Retired). _**Today, I write to you not as a soldier... _but as a father._**_ I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and **Purple Heart Medal** recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and Purple Heart Medal recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. I’ve buried friends who never made it home. And I’ve felt the sting of a Nation that sometimes forgets what our sacrifices were for. But my daughter - Congresswoman Nancy Mace - never forgot. Nancy was raised in the shadow of the flag. She saw the uniform. She lived with the deployments. She knew the cost. And instead of running from it, she ran toward it. That’s the kind of person -the kind of fighter \- she is. When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school. Most kids in that situation fall apart. But not Nancy. I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -how you rise does. She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: 👉 Never quit. 👉 Never run from the truth.👉 And never let anyone tell you thatyou are less than what God made you to be. So I gave her a choice: She picked herself up, took a job at Waffle House, and fought her way back. By 21, she became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, following in my footsteps. Soon after, she was elected as the first woman to represent South Carolina in the U.S. House of Representatives. She’s been fighting her whole life; for herself, for her kids, for the truth, and now...for her state. Nancy led an evacuation mission in the Middle East after learning a South Carolina family was stranded. Because when your people are stuck in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office -worthy of our country \- is to get them out. Friend,

**Tennessee can’t afford to wait for real change.** Families across our state need relief and now. That’s why **Jerri has a[plan for Day One](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127565815/608495313/-221825606?refcode=3.18.26_DayOnePlan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTU3NDkyYi1kYjIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zhe0tWo580a3grpDbE1cZafFp4BeGNZyEWT6V01OAME=&emci=0a461361-8a21-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=ee57492b-db22-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271#:~:text=Our%20Day%20One%20Plan)**, focused on things that she can take immediate action on as Governor to help working people across Tennessee.
_**On Day One,_we will work on:_**_
* **Housing Relief:** Use $10M in TANF funding to _**waive security deposits and help 100,000+ families secure housing.**_
* **Childcare for All:** Use $50M in TANF funds to _**eliminate the childcare waitlist**_ so parents can work without worry.
* **End Medical Debt:** Use $10M to buy and _**erase predatory medical debt for 100,000+ Tennesseans.**_
* **Protect Reproductive Freedom:** Sign an executive order _**protecting doctors**_ who provide women’s healthcare.
* **Stop ICE Cooperation:** End cooperation between Tennessee Highway Patrol and ICE.
* **Restore Expert Leadership:** Appoint qualified leaders in _**Education, Health, and the Attorney General’s office.**_
* **Put People Over Profit:** End private prison contracts with CoreCivic and challenge Ballad Health’s monopoly.
* **Keep TVA Public:** Affirm that TVA remains a _**public utility serving the people,**_ not corporate profits

Jerri has also been talking about these ideas in several recent podcast interviews—[ _**Click here to listen to Jerri discuss her plan to improve the lives of Tennesseans in her own words**_.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127565823/608495326/2136462740?refcode=3.18.26_DayOnePlan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTU3NDkyYi1kYjIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zhe0tWo580a3grpDbE1cZafFp4BeGNZyEWT6V01OAME=&emci=0a461361-8a21-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=ee57492b-db22-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271#:~:text=Tune%20in%20to%20a%20Podcast%20with%20Jerri) Recently Jerri sat down with renowned Nashville drag queen, Vivica Steele on The Queen's Table to discuss the ins and outs of her run for governor.
