**The Fast That Changed My Life**
I used to think fasting was something people did only for religious reasons, or because they didn't have food. As a former Division 1 college football player, I never missed a snack, much less a meal. My life revolved around constant fueling, steady eating, and hitting macros. Then, in 2017, I stumbled across an article about Silicon Valley CEOs voluntarily going 72 hours without food, not to lose weight, but to boost mental performance.
It sounded crazy. But it also sparked something in me. That curiosity led me down a road I never expected. One that would reshape my understanding of health, completely transform my own relationship with food, and eventually become the foundation for my _Fast.Eat.Live._ Lifestyle Nutrition System.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.QTX3Mplb26d75h5ZkK4KlccbpdzyWCqOAmEtmTNdkWE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=191366057)
**The Article That Started It All**
The _Guardian_ piece described high-powered tech executives--data-driven, sleep-deprived innovators--fasting for three days at a time, testing their focus and creativity while in a fasted state.
For someone like me, raised on the belief that frequent eating was essential for performance, the idea was almost laughable. But there was something intriguing about it, too. If they could perform better by _not_ eating, what might happen if I tried it?

**Jumping In. No Training, No Plan**
In true "crash test dummy" fashion, I dove straight into a 72-hour water fast. No easing in. No expert guidance. No understanding of how my body might respond.
Day one was easy until dinner time, but I pushed through it and went to bed early. Day Two began like any other. I woke up at 4:00 a.m., left for work at 4:30, and headed to my first client session at 5:00. Halfway there, I started feeling... off. My head was spinning. My thoughts slowed. It was almost like being intoxicated without touching a drop of alcohol.
When I got to the gym, I told my client, "I'm fasting, and I feel like my brain's spinning out of control. Do I sound like I'm talking in slow motion?"
He laughed. "What are you doing now? You're always testing something on yourself."

**The Switch Flips**
Twenty minutes later, the fog lifted--and something amazing happened. My mind sped up. Words came faster. Ideas flowed easily. It felt like I'd taken the _Limitless_ pill.
I didn't know it at the time, but I had just entered **ketosis** for the first time in my life. My body had switched from burning carbs to burning fat for fuel. The even, steady energy was unlike anything I'd felt before--no highs, no crashes, just clarity. I felt at peace in my gut for the first time.

**Breaking the Fast --Poorly**
The rest of the fast went surprisingly smoothly. Hunger came in waves but never overwhelmed me. I made it all the way to Friday evening--St. Patrick's Day.
For my wife and me, St. Patty's is the anniversary of the day we met. She's the Artful Palate, famous for her holiday spreads. Waiting for me that night: Irish bangers and mash, corned beef and cabbage, and a pint of Guinness.
If you're wondering about the _worst_ way to break a 72-hour fast, I can tell you: that was it. My stomach didn't thank me, but my taste buds sure did.

**From Curiosity to Obsession**
That first fast lit a fire in me. Why did my brain feel so sharp? Why was my gut so calm? Why did I have even energy for the first time in my life?
I began studying fasting relentlessly reading research papers, watching documentaries, and exploring its effects on inflammation, metabolism, and disease. I learned how cultures around the world (Russians, Swiss, Italians) have used medically supervised fasting to heal conditions like autoimmune disease, obesity, and mental illness.
As someone raised in the 1980s American "three meals a day plus snacks" culture, it was a revelation.

**Lessons from the Wilderness**
Around the same time, one of my clients (head of the biostatistics lab at the University of Washington) was hooked on the TV series _Alone_. We talked about it during training sessions.
That season, Sam Larson won by lasting 60 days in the Mongolian wilderness. His strategy: gain 70 pounds beforehand, then conserve energy and live off his fat reserves. Critics called it "starving," but to me, it was proof of what the human body can do.
Contrary to popular belief, fasting doesn't shut down your metabolism. Done properly, it triggers healing processes, improves gut health, and activates autophagy your body's cellular repair system.

**Enter Dr. Valter Longo**
My research led me to Dr. Valter Longo at USC, whose work showed that fasting before chemotherapy could protect healthy cells while making cancer cells more vulnerable.
The principle, called **Differential Stress Resistance (DSR)** , happens because fasting puts healthy cells into a repair mode, lowering insulin and IGF-1 levels, while cancer cells locked in growth mode remain exposed. His early animal studies were groundbreaking, and human trials have followed.

**Ancient Wisdom Meets Modern Science**
The deeper I dug, the more I saw that fasting wasn't a new trend, it was ancient wisdom. Hippocrates prescribed fasting and fermented foods for healing. The Bible is filled with examples of fasting as both a physical and spiritual discipline.
Science now confirms what the ancients practiced: fasting restores gut integrity, lowers inflammation, and supports overall resilience.

Years of personal practice, research, and client coaching led me to create **Fast.Eat.Live.** A lifestyle nutrition system, not a fad diet.
We fast _once a week_ in Phase 1, train the body to switch fuel sources in Phase 2, and celebrate food with friends and family on Phase 3 "Live Days."
The results I've seen in thousands of clients include:
* Restored hunger signals and a healthy relationship with food
* Stabilized hormone balance
* Increased fat-burning and lean mass retention
* Reduced inflammation and stronger immune function
* Improved confidence and self-discipline

**Why Fasting Works for Today 's World**
Modern life revolves around constant eating often processed, low-quality food. We snack out of boredom and stress, never giving our digestive systems a rest.
Fasting interrupts that cycle. It teaches metabolic flexibility, restores awareness to eating, and allows the body to operate the way it was designed. Best of all--it's free.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Salon: Trump is going all in on the SAVE America Act. It could make voting harder for millions [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031826_1&amount=25]
Folks, we've been warning you about voter suppression bills like the SAVE Act, the MEGA Act, and the SAVE America Act since they were introduced, since they represent a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote.
President Trump is, unsurprisingly, all in and refusing to sign any other legislation until this suppressive legislation passes. The SAVE America Act would require Americans to register to vote in person with documentary proof of citizenship — in most cases a birth certificate or passport. It narrowly passed the House in February, a week after Trump called for Republicans to “ nationalize voting .”
If the SAVE America Act were passed, it would mark the first time in U.S. history that Congress restricted the right to vote , according to Michael Waldman, president and CEO of the nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031826_1&amount=35]
It's simple: With Trump focused on re-litigating the 2020 election, this legislation would give him all the power he would need to take federal control of the upcoming midterms .
These bills are a sweeping attack on voting rights. The SAVE America Act could:
* Impose a strict photo ID requirement to vote
* Create a centralized voter surveillance system in every state
* Mandate constant voter roll purges, gutting the “Motor Voter” law that expanded access to voter registration
* Bar states from counting ballots that arrive after Election Day
* Ban universal mail voting, in which states mail a ballot to all registered voters
* Bar the federal funding for voter registration by outside groups
* Unleash lawsuits against election officials
Estimates said the SAVE America Act could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities. The fact that 217 members of the House voted to pass it and it's now been brought up for debate in the Senate is highlighting how perilously close we are to severe damage to our democracy.
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for voting. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE America Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031826_1&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=031826_1&amount=35]
Back to Michael Waldman, president and CEO of the nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice:
“ Congress, when it has gotten involved, has worked to expand the vote, to stop abuse of power. If this law passes, it would be the most restrictive voting bill ever passed by Congress. To turn back the clock rather than advancing our democracy — that has not happened before. ”
He's not alone. Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School and a leading historian of voting rights said this about the SAVE Act (the original version of the SAVE America Act):
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this . It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
This bill is nothing less than an all-out partisan assault on our fundamental right to vote . If made law, this bill would codify MAGA's power for decades to come, invalidating millions of eligible voters and ending our democracy for a generation or longer.
We can't sit back, Team, and watch our fundamental right to vote die. Fight back against opponents of voting rights and their suppressive bills with $35 or whatever you can before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031826_1&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=031826_1&amount=20]

In the anatomy of a failing democracy, the fifth sign of fascism is **Rampant Sexism.** Fascist regimes are defined by an obsession with rigid gender roles and the systemic erasure of anyone who doesn't fit a patriarchal mold. Under this ideology, the state doesn't just govern; it polices identity itself. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsCgbBF5rm9TF3OCm2PlAzc830mH0SaEU79yenHkofnNxmYVU0KaNelsGDLQBgZYnw_TLU4ud3LTKaTO7PuapHWBtSwDuHOU_1PJDmfavtIPpREm3Rl9zw_Dw5RcsPhx1qUJ95mQwS34OyzlDX2Mcem-IVY_RirM_UAMhJegf4csqEFiGEMqRnFlze1iHlLzRXCfjwORkOp_Tg_8fIfCxpduTTy07PxHPdsiTZU5dra0teW8_7OLttVXVPi7jKcpnJ7MWe5bqOIntOT6R4PbLnPL2ADYFxWKsrzKQm2Rfybp06WlNolqGS-WTvJSHGlH-etu9-0EOw47dsskj8abwpE/4p1/Y1pg3mvFT2KRKzlp88TZzw/h0/h001.CWKCaRCcDSQqm3Zew5QXeHmcTDCfCD-YHekF3Fdolqc)The crisis in Kansas is the modern-day "patient zero" for this shift. By[ invalidating the driver’s licenses and birth certificates](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMeDN9TLiev5hRhF3UtBaO9lsThLN_AzrW9T0cARcBz0BupsKaBQQ8Ozbsebv9-A7luF1BGaBRCcPE_TpDDg-UXuTrPh-8as5QdGQ_-OsfIGDp7pD6U85R4q3AiSoSXbA9BFy-RlluMKY8dmF_gfBH3LJzdQ_gMhCZwu4ZbsrHtec4FnEQxKUoK3v6YGiRgLBfo5w0LxfGq2lF5jmxmGoS7PB9tdZOj6Y6OqLb4RGsKboO8Ri2AJIWabjbJ9IXMXVEEREHgn3GTEKHKKucyrljGEiE2z-hB8sXDdumVgNudoG5_A8kglD4Ns6w8Cb2mX7REAR8NkASClCGRQGU3krdCqOK7xHvuIxZ31JV8J5Q-G44xUop5dk8rIXEhzTc_2ubpwLw4Hv6TjWmxeuKG6rqpOESi9wCoQniE4z41KirIBO/4p1/Y1pg3mvFT2KRKzlp88TZzw/h1/h001.YqaYAWsRUAYzcSXMPVE2jRCgEkxmo4XRGbn6q7SkyU8) of over 1,000 transgender residents, MAGA extremists are doing more than just passing a law; they are practicing state-sponsored identity theft. **_Make no mistake: They never stop at one group. This is the opening salvo in a broader war on autonomy._** When a government claims the power to decide who is "man" or "woman" enough to hold a legal ID, they are building the infrastructure to control reproductive freedom, marriage, and the safety of every person who defies their narrow worldview. **_If they can erase the identity of a trans person today, they can invalidate your rights tomorrow._** **Local Democracy Project is the frontline of the resistance. name: Britney VanCitters
subject: We’re taking climate seriously. So are these candidates.
body:
https://www.olcv.org/2026-primary/ [https://www.olcv.org/2026-primary/]
Peter,
As climate impacts worsen across Oregon, it’s more important than ever to elect leaders who will stand up for our environment and push for bold climate action.
That’s why OLCV is proud to announce our 2026 primary endorsements. . [https://www.olcv.org/2026-primary/] These are candidates who have made climate and environmental protection a top priority in their leadership and legislative work.
For legislative incumbents, you will notice something different. We are highlighting our best legislative champions by only endorsing incumbents who have demonstrated exceptional leadership on our issues. That means we’ve endorsed incumbents who have prioritized climate and the environment as a top priority or who earned 100% on OLCV’s 2025 Environmental Scorecard. In addition, we are endorsing champions running in key open legislative seats.
Unfortunately, the last two legislative sessions made it clear that the Oregon Legislature as a whole is not yet meeting the urgency of the climate crisis. We’ve seen an increase in harmful environmental bills moving through the legislature, and little meaningful progress on climate justice and the transition to clean energy.
Because of this, we are being more targeted with our endorsements just for this primary, by focusing our support on the candidates who have shown they will truly lead on climate. However, if your state senator or representative is not endorsed in the primary, that doesn’t mean they are not pro-environment or worthy of your vote. You can check out our Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] to find their voting record.
We also want to highlight some champions running in open seats across the state who earned OLCV’s endorsement for the 2026 primary. We trust these champs to fight to protect our climate, forests, water, and communities:
* Tonia Moro, Senate District 3 (Ashland/Medford)
* Nicole Bassett, Senate District 26 (Hood River/Sandy)
* David Osborn, House District 52 (Hood River)
* Nafisa Fai, Washington County Chair
* Jamie Collins, Deschutes County Commissioner Position 1
Check out our endorsements [https://www.olcv.org/2026-primary/]
There are some races we did not make a primary endorsement in. However, as we head into the general election, our board will be revisiting these races for any additional endorsements.
As an OLCV member, I want to thank you for being part of a community that is working to elect leaders who will fight for Oregon’s future. Together, we can ensure our state has the bold climate leadership this moment demands.
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director

By Illinois Review

Darren Bailey’s decisive victory in Tuesday’s Republican gubernatorial primary wasn’t just a win for a candidate – it was a clear rejection of the political class, consultant-driven campaigns, and the failed playbook pushed by two of Illinois’ most prominent GOP operatives.

With more than 53 percent of the vote, Bailey defeated Ted Dabrowski by a wide margin, securing nearly 300,000 votes statewide. Dabrowski, despite heavy backing from establishment voices and media allies, finished a distant second at just under 29 percent.

The race was called shortly after polls closed.

body:
| With everything that has happened, I still believe that right matters. **“Here, right matters.”** That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States. [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6025?t=3&akid=9650%2E5257348%2E4CMg_j) It’s Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman, Derek. I never intended to be in the national spotlight. I joined the Army and served for 21 years because I wanted to fight and defend the country I love. I could have never expected that it would lead me to testify against the President of the United States. _That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo._ I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption. I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past. [**But I had confidence that I could tell the truth. I knew that this is America, and here, right matters. That’s why I am asking you to split a donation between my Senate campaign and Adam Schiff before my monthly fundraising deadline.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6025?t=4&akid=9650%2E5257348%2E4CMg_j) | [ DONATE ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6025?t=5&akid=9650%2E5257348%2E4CMg_j)
---
A lot has happened since that day in 2019. President Trump exacted his revenge by firing me and calling me “human scum.” He tried to incite an insurrection to hold onto power after losing a fair election. Now, he is using his powers in office to inflict violence on American citizens.
Amidst all of this, I still believe that right matters.
Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past, but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union.
We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here...but only if we make it matter.
**That’s why I have decided to run for the United States Senate in Florida. We are taking the fight straight to Donald Trump in his own backyard. A win here will deliver Democrats control of the Senate.**

name: Mark Smith for Congress
subject: First to File 🇺🇸 Our Campaign Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MARK SMITH FOR CONGRESS
body:
On Monday, I was the first candidate to file for Congress in South Carolina’s First District. | | | | [ ](https://VoteMarkSmith.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75ca839227bb28c57ff73dffe&id=1d7dd5f58a&e=d4051626af)
---
| | | **Dear Friend,** On Monday, I was the first candidate to file for Congress in South Carolina’s First District. 🇺🇸 I was proud to have my wife Elayne and our son Parker by my side, along with the volunteers and team members who are stepping up to help us win this fight. Washington is broken. Career politicians have forgotten who they work for. I’m running for Congress to stand up for the Lowcountry, defend our conservative values, and bring real leadership to Washington. This campaign is about fighting for our families, our communities, and the future of South Carolina. Let’s go win this!

_Here's more from the campaign trail!_
* * *
**☀️ BEAUFORT COUNTY CANDIDATE FORUMS** I enjoyed criss-crossing Beaufort County, joining the other candidates for Congress and debating the key issues that are affecting everyone in the Lowcountry!

* * *
**📉 TAX RELIEF FOR SOUTH CAROLINA** Tax relief is on the way for South Carolina! Last week in the State House, I just helped pass legislation aligning key provisions from President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill, bringing major tax relief to South Carolinians. ✅ No tax on tips
✅ No tax on overtime
✅ Higher standard deductions for families In Congress, I’ll keep fighting to make sure South Carolina families keep more of what they earn.
* * *
**🌴 VISITING BEAUFORT COUNTY** Last Saturday, I was honored to have both State Senator Tom Davis and Hardeeville Mayor Harry Williams both speak at my grassroots event. We heard from fired up GOP activists who are ready to keep SC-1 red in November!
---
|
---
|
* * *
**🚫 BAN CONGRESSIONAL STOCK TRADING** It's important you know where I stand on key issues. Recently, I called for a BAN on Congressional stock trading, **because if you write the laws, you shouldn’t profit from them.** I'm not running for Congress to build a portfolio. I'm running to fight for the Lowcountry. President Trump called for it. The American people demand it. Let’s get it done.
---
|
---
|
* * *
**💡 PROTECT RATEPAYERS** South Carolina families should NOT be forced to subsidize billion-dollar data centers. As President Trump made clear in his State of the Union address, America must lead in innovation — but we must do it responsibly. I’m working in the Statehouse, across party lines, to put safeguards in place to protect ratepayers from footing the bill for massive new energy demand. If data centers want to build here, they should be allowed to generate their own required on-site power, return excess energy to the grid to strengthen it rather than strain it, and use closed-loop reclaimed water systems to responsibly cool their servers and protect our local water resources. That’s a true win-win relationship! **We will always protect ratepayers and local communities. That’s non-negotiable.**
---
|
---

State Rep. Mark Smith

name: Sean Feucht
subject: Read my latest on Substack: St. Patrick’s Day in a World of Wars: The Gospel Still Goes Forth.
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
| | Somewhere above the clouds, between where we have been and where we are going, it becomes easier to see things clearly.

History compresses. Priorities sharpen. And figures like St. Patrick stop feeling distant and start feeling uncomfortably relevant.

Patrick did not step into a receptive, spiritually curious culture. He walked into a world that did not know—or care to know—the message he carried. The Ireland he returned to was not waiting for him. It was resistant, unfamiliar, and in many ways indifferent. And yet, he went. Not because conditions were ideal, but because they weren’t.

That is precisely why his life speaks so powerfully to this moment.

We are living in what may be the most strategic era in history for the spread of the gospel. Global travel is routine. Barriers that once isolated entire regions have weakened. Information flows instantly. Entire populations that were once unreachable are now accessible in ways unimaginable even a generation ago.

And yet, the need remains staggering. And figures like St. Patrick stop feeling distant and start feeling uncomfortably relevant. Patrick did not step into a receptive, spiritually curious culture. He walked into a world that did not know—or care to know—the message he carried. The Ireland he returned to was not waiting for him. It was resistant, unfamiliar, and in many ways indifferent. And yet, he went. Not because conditions were ideal, but because they weren’t. That is precisely why his life speaks so powerfully to this moment. We are living in what may be the most strategic era in history for the spread of the gospel. Global travel is routine. Barriers that once isolated entire regions have weakened. name: Anika Page
subject: Dispatch from the Dome: Reform, Regulation, and What Comes Next at the Capitol
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/dome-dispatch-12852521?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Good morning Friend,
As the legislative session moves into its final stretch, the focus at the Capitol is beginning to shift. Major policy bills are clearing their final hurdles, others have quietly fallen away, and attention is now turning toward the biggest issue left unresolved: the state budget. Here’s a look at what moved last week — and what it means for Mississippi.
---
|
### **Modernizing Alcohol Laws: A Shift Toward Freedom and Local Control**
Lawmakers advanced two notable alcohol-related measures:
* Direct-to-consumer liquor shipping
* A local option for Sunday alcohol sales

While these may seem like small changes, they reflect a broader policy shift. For years, Mississippi’s alcohol laws have been shaped by outdated restrictions and one-size-fits-all rules. These proposals move in a different direction — toward **greater individual choice and local decision-making**. Instead of statewide mandates, communities would have more authority to decide what works best for them, and consumers would have more flexibility in how they purchase products. It’s a step toward modernization — and toward trusting Mississippians to make their own decisions.
---
|
### **Workforce Development: Cutting Red Tape and Strengthening Opportunity**
Another important development this week was the passage of legislation to create a **state-run Office of Apprenticeship**. This change would shift oversight away from the federal government and place it at the state level. Supporters argue this will:
* Reduce federal bureaucracy
* Improve coordination with Mississippi employers
* Strengthen workforce pipelines in key industries

At its core, this is about making workforce development more responsive to **Mississippi’s actual economic needs** — not a federal template. As our state continues to grow and attract new investment, aligning workforce training with real-world demand will be critical.
---
|
### **The Biggest Issue Ahead: Budget Negotiations**
With most policy deadlines now behind us, the Legislature is turning its attention to the state budget — a process that is already underway. Lawmakers are working to finalize a **$7+ billion budget** , and early signs point to familiar challenges:
* Ongoing tension between House and Senate leadership
* Competing priorities on spending and fiscal strategy
* Questions about how to avoid last year’s late-session breakdown

The budget will define the final weeks of the session — and how it’s handled matters. A disciplined, transparent approach to spending is essential to maintaining Mississippi’s recent economic momentum.
---
|
### **Could a Special Session Be Ahead?**
Given the dynamics already in play, there is growing discussion about the possibility of a **special session** if lawmakers are unable to reach agreement before adjournment. Mississippi faced this situation just last year, when unresolved budget negotiations required lawmakers to return to Jackson to finish their work. If that happens again, it will raise important questions about process, priorities, and how major decisions are being made. For a deeper look at this issue, you can read Douglas Carswell’s most recent piece outlining the case for a potential special session on education reform:
---
| [The Case for a Special Session](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=de1e9db425&e=5703353baa "The Case for a Special Session")
---
|
### **Looking Ahead**
The final phase of the legislative session is often where the most consequential decisions are made. With policy debates largely settled, the focus now shifts to:
* Final budget negotiations
* Potential end-of-session compromises
* And whether lawmakers can complete their work within the regular session

---
|
### **Track Legislation in Real Time**
If you’d like to follow along as bills move through the process, you can track key legislation throughout the session using the Mississippi Center for Public Policy’s bill tracker.
---
| [Track Bills at the Capitol](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=e276196e66&e=5703353baa "Track Bills at the Capitol")
---
| Thanks for following along as the session continues to unfold.
I’ll keep tracking what’s moving at the Capitol and breaking it down here each week.
---
| |
---
Until next time,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

body:

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7083?t=6&akid=757%2E124072%2EE_L2JT)
Peter –

I just filed to be on the ballot in Virginia.
**[Now I am reaching out to you to ask you to split a donation between Roy Cooper's campaign and me to become a 2026 Founding Donor to my campaign. The work ahead is too important to leave anything on the table.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7083?t=7&akid=757%2E124072%2EE_L2JT)**
Frankly, the challenges we're facing right now demand real leadership. Prices keep rising, and the job market is shifting beneath our feet. Americans are facing a never-before-seen health care crisis.
Yet our president hasn’t done a damn thing about it. He’s more focused on handing out tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy and vanity projects to the White House. And now, he’s launching the United States into another war of choice.
We need leaders with big ideas and a willingness to bring people together and get stuff done so we can turn the page on this dangerous administration and chart a new path forward – that’s the fight I’m leading right now.

But I need you with me.
**[Will you split a donation right now between Roy Cooper's campaign and my campaign to help us hit our 10,000 Founding Donor goal before midnight Friday?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7083?t=8&akid=757%2E124072%2EE_L2JT)**

subject: You said it clearly: End the war on Iran!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party PAC (77 Sands St
body:
| | | Peter, We’ve been going through your responses to our March 2026 WFP Supporter Survey, and the message is coming through loud and clear: **people are scared, angry, and do not want another war carried out in our name.** What’s unfolding in Iran is devastating. Families are being torn apart, communities are living in fear, and people are being forced to endure violence they did not choose. And war isn’t just fought overseas — it puts American troops' lives on the line while driving up costs here at home, from gas to groceries, and pulls resources away from the things people actually need, with ripple effects that leave us less safe here and around the world. **So many of you said the same thing in your survey responses: this war is wrong, and it must end now.** [**Add your name to demand Congress****put a stop to this: Not a single dollar more for Trump’s illegal war.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN9-W3f5EPLTOZcNMqvgnDAP_HKg8bvFbJXI2aiEr0VtN5355ekloDX8fyGHqOx-WKW-spS9WDpzEAtQILc72Wa4V67nO6-HEek--z0MnKW-xvkbc-D9s3xhrGEYQT5h0U0W78DytGh9niMfIEvBS3b3-jQh3aTm2osU_439A5hi0i5mhDipU8mVogi0dxpuAlwj2IxW7pNyjH_NBh2KDg69MgR9nNAbaJsBrusFJI6j2nuAwaJbCdJbBnHEoQttl49U14pp7w1VqF96x0th6jfoCMoGIeT3elXvSmmiibQ-KtSI2zlVsl6jn9wqPhaz6uv/4p1/0oFyxpHTTO-rTcyh_LjM1A/h0/h001.Oy1rToBVhgEJXfETQp43JaulcG9KgDNea0Zxu-nweT0) **[Add your name »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN9-W3f5EPLTOZcNMqvgnDAP_HKg8bvFbJXI2aiEr0VtN5355ekloDX8fyGHqOx-WKW-spS9WDpzEAtQILc72Wa4V67nO6-HEek--z0MnKW-xvkbc-D9s3xhrGEYQT5h0U0hxEc4syPBaqg84J59F_OLVLyf_GjyPZ6dzVyoyjja7bwTdiqMxIP2KzDyTp_NvTra8xt9GtMh-VpQ9to24reJ8Bul9_Nmxs3NGMHiihl_vcELdOqMN9Bv4gs_YCZ3R_DHDl2bgsL-shjSDKFCeu-SgL2RYF3YVO-3YaFffQ5jum1blzldsCr0x_6BfxX6Q7O/4p1/0oFyxpHTTO-rTcyh_LjM1A/h1/h001.MHHtUVi1PvlZbugvMlX2rwPmxQ0UdRQtMzlBUubRE5s)** As this war continues, the consequences grow more severe by the day:
* More than 1,900 people killed — most of them Iranian civilians, including over 200 children1
* Over 18,500 people injured2
* 45 million people at risk of acute hunger if this continues through June3

**These aren’t just numbers — they are human beings with families, futures, and communities that deserve safety and peace.** People in Iran and across the region are carrying the heaviest burden, Peter — facing loss, displacement, and constant threat of violence. And here at home, the impact is different but connected. Families worrying about loved ones being sent into danger while rising costs are pushing working people further to the edge. The Pentagon says the U.S. is spending $1 billion each day on this war.4 That is money that could be going to our schools, health care, housing, and infrastructure. Instead, working families are paying the price. It’s no surprise, then, that when we asked how you feel about U.S. military involvement in Iran, **more than 90% of you strongly opposed it.** You also made clear what this means for your day-to-day lives. **Nearly 90% of you are deeply concerned about rising costs,** and you shared frustration that political leaders continue to escalate military action while ordinary people are left to carry the consequences. Many of you shared what this moment is actually looking like in your lives:
> _“I’m an Iranian-American. Half my family is U.S. military and the other half is in Iran. I have cousins bombing cousins.”_
> _“My friend hasn’t heard from her parents in Tehran since the bombing.”_
> _“I fear for the safety of my granddaughter and great-granddaughter who live in Israel. I fear that my grandsons who are in the Army and Air Force may be sent to war.”_
> _“I have a nephew in the Marines, and I don’t want him fighting this illegal war.”_
> _“Gas has gone up $1 per gallon in just a week... we’re having to redo our budget and it’s tight.”_
These stories make clear what war actually does — it tears families apart, devastates communities, and pulls resources away from what people need to live with dignity. And when we asked where those billions of dollars should go instead, your answers were consistent: **health care, housing, food, and education.** We’ve seen this pattern before. There is always money for war, but never enough for the programs and services that working people need. **That is a choice. And it’s a choice we can challenge together.** Congress has the power to step in and stop this, but only if they feel real pressure to act. [**Add your name to demand****that Congress refuse to fund Trump’s illegal war in Iran****.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN9-W3f5EPLTOZcNMqvgnDAP_HKg8bvFbJXI2aiEr0VtN5355ekloDX8fyGHqOx-WKW-spS9WDpzEAtQILc72Wa4V67nO6-HEek--z0MnKW-xvkbc-D9s3xhrGEYQT5h0U0MrC2B9D3Z6WWNsr9DMRMX4PBAKjh8NBf2HWtwQ1GHs24R5FzrYNqWBjQmJpqcilIsloAixdcGOsnSyQlbOthaP1bkemyY7PvfQCAFpfYqgB-Dlqn5CYO49GL-HvuAc-nv1IZ-8U9sVTkxHBVkjJMhrx8b3LzD538LDVpHkckDaO9a_j6JnvM9eK_vGna8VBI/4p1/0oFyxpHTTO-rTcyh_LjM1A/h2/h001.H_lsXINV-t81efkGCWUwxN41ynTUMMvLWR602IbMXU8) **[Add your name »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN9-W3f5EPLTOZcNMqvgnDAP_HKg8bvFbJXI2aiEr0VtN5355ekloDX8fyGHqOx-WKW-spS9WDpzEAtQILc72Wa4V67nO6-HEek--z0MnKW-xvkbc-D9s3xhrGEYQT5h0U0AXlPSseGM9T4HzpXxoL9BBUnfuwv_jIGL8RSP-aWCoHb68iwQy6Tt5_Xf0MSMczwZClXjc7dDHH9NUIppKDgRkr5yCACbS5sWFqBVAPmdm9K_pY6LnyoxP9tITREfYTIbj9q4PXA44I5M8eCdn6XgSXAnKL0VXQOGOoZ5V-MMkT8WpBM2IBRUXfAtv1gGg3K/4p1/0oFyxpHTTO-rTcyh_LjM1A/h3/h001.11e74xnghKMDjm94d2cIeFivltrVj5Usl2S-nAIrrtM)** Thank you for speaking up, for sharing what this moment looks like in your life, and for standing with people here and around the world who deserve peace and stability. clean_body: | | | Peter, We’ve been going through your responses to our March 2026 WFP Supporter Survey, and the message is coming through loud and clear: people are scared, angry, and do not want another war carried out in our name. What’s unfolding in Iran is devastating. Families are being torn apart, communities are living in fear, and people are being forced to endure violence they did not choose. And war isn’t just fought overseas — it puts American troops' lives on the line while driving up costs here at home, from gas to groceries, and pulls resources away from the things people actually need, with ripple effects that leave us less safe here and around the world. So many of you said the same thing in your survey responses: this war is wrong, and it must end now. As this war continues, the consequences grow more severe by the day: More than 1,900 people killed — most of them Iranian civilians, including over 200 children1 Over 18,500 people injured2 45 million people at risk of acute hunger if this continues through June3 These aren’t just numbers — they are human beings with families, futures, and communities that deserve safety and peace. People in Iran and across the region are carrying the heaviest burden, Peter — facing loss, displacement, and constant threat of violence. And here at home, the impact is different but connected. Families worrying about loved ones being sent into danger while rising costs are pushing working people further to the edge. The Pentagon says the U.S. is spending $1 billion each day on this war.4 That is money that could be going to our schools, health care, housing, and infrastructure. Instead, working families are paying the price. It’s no surprise, then, that when we asked how you feel about U.S. military involvement in Iran, more than 90% of you strongly opposed it. You also made clear what this means for your day-to-day lives. Nearly 90% of you are deeply concerned about rising costs, and you shared frustration that political leaders continue to escalate military action while ordinary people are left to carry the consequences. Many of you shared what this moment is actually looking like in your lives: “I’m an Iranian-American. Half my family is U.S. military and the other half is in Iran. I have cousins bombing cousins.” “My friend hasn’t heard from her parents in Tehran since the bombing.” “I fear for the safety of my granddaughter and great-granddaughter who live in Israel. I fear that my grandsons who are in the Army and Air Force may be sent to war.” “I have a nephew in the Marines, and I don’t want him fighting this illegal war.” “Gas has gone up $1 per gallon in just a week... we’re having to redo our budget and it’s tight.” These stories make clear what war actually does — it tears families apart, devastates communities, and pulls resources away from what people need to live with dignity. And when we asked where those billions of dollars should go instead, your answers were consistent: health care, housing, food, and education. We’ve seen this pattern before. There is always money for war, but never enough for the programs and services that working people need. That is a choice. And it’s a choice we can challenge together. Congress has the power to step in and stop this, but only if they feel real pressure to act. Thank you for speaking up, for sharing what this moment looks like in your life, and for standing with people here and around the world who deserve peace and stability. ## **2,000 Signatures in 4 Weeks**
## **— Let’s Make It Happen**
---
Friends,
The energy across Wisconsin’s 5th District continues to build — and I’m incredibly grateful for the **continued support from our district leaders and county Democratic parties** who are stepping up and helping power this campaign forward. We are building something real — and people are taking notice.
Earlier this month, I was proud to help organize the **West Bend Governors Forum at The Bend Theater on March 10th**. The event was a **sell-out** , with a packed crowd of engaged voters ready to hear directly from candidates and be part of the democratic process. I also had the chance to host an information table and connect with so many of you — conversations like these are what fuel this campaign.
I’m continuing that momentum this week. Tonight, **March 18** , I’ll be meeting with the **Carroll University Progressives** , and on **April 9th** , I’ll be speaking at the **Walworth County Democrats meeting in Elkhorn**. These are exactly the kinds of conversations that help grow our movement and bring new voices into this campaign.And now, we’re launching something new.
I’m excited to kick off a series of **“Coffee Talk” community gatherings** across the district — informal, open conversations where we can connect directly. The first one is happening:
📍 **Sippie Hippie — Slinger**
🗓 **March 19th**
🕐 **1:00 PM**
These events are about listening, sharing ideas, and building relationships — one conversation at a time.You can find **all upcoming events on our website** , and I hope to see you at one soon.
Behind the scenes, I’ve also been working hard on **endorsement interviews with major unions** , including the **UAW, NEA, and AFSCME**. These conversations are critical — because this campaign is about standing up for working people and rebuilding the middle class.
**Now — I need your help in a big way.**
**Nomination signature collection begins April 14th** , and our goal is ambitious: **2,000 signatures in just four weeks**.
We can absolutely get there — but only if we show up and work the crowds across the district. Events, gatherings, busy public spaces — everywhere we go, everyone we talk to, is an opportunity to build support and get on the ballot strong. This is the way our democratic process works!
**Nomination sheets and instructions are available on our website** and can be downloaded directly. If you’d prefer printed copies, reach out — I’ll personally make sure you get what you need.
We are also actively scheduling speaking engagements across the district — with **unions, church groups, civic organizations, and community groups**. If you can help connect us, host an event, or assist with scheduling, we need you. Help us **fill the calendar and expand our reach** — because that’s how we win.
There are only **146 days** until the August 11th primary — and just **230 days** until the general election.
That’s not a lot of time.
We need to ramp up now — more events, more conversations, more organizing. Together, we can build the momentum needed to **defeat Scott Fitzgerald** and bring real leadership back to Wisconsin and the Country!
Thank you for being part of this movement. Let’s keep going.
In solidarity,
**Andy**

Peter,
For decades, Democrats have played by the rules while Republicans ruthlessly gerrymandered their way to power.
We took the high road. We preached about norms and precedent. We talked about "when they go low, we go high."
And where did that get us?
A rigged system where Republicans can lose the popular vote by millions and still control Congress. A democracy where the will of the people is crushed under the weight of partisan maps drawn in backrooms by MAGA operatives.
Well, that era just ended.
Democrats across the country are done being punching bags! California unleashed Proposition 50. New York, Virginia, and Maryland are redrawing their maps.
The "nuclear option" has been deployed and there's no going back.
But here's the brutal reality: Democrats cannot unilaterally surrender while Republicans are rigging the game in Texas, North Carolina, Missouri, Florida, and Indiana.
If we don't use every single card in the book while MAGA ramps up their attacks, we guarantee that Democrats will never retake the House. Not in 2026. Not in 2028. Not for a generation.
Trump would have unchecked power to invade countries, dismantle the Federal Reserve, prosecute his enemies, and turn America into an authoritarian nightmare--and there wouldn't be a damn thing we could do to stop him.
That's not an option.
Coloradans are committed to fighting back tooth and nail, because the time for rolling over in the Trump-era is DONE.
This is why Colorado Draws the Line is spearheading the ballot initiative that will erase 3 to 4 GOP seats off the Colorado map and stop Trump's election rigging scheme dead in its tracks. We're not apologizing for it. We're not ashamed of it. And we're sure as hell not backing down.
MAGA wants a fight? They've got one.
[Will you rush $50, $30, $15, or whatever you can spare to help Colorado join the Democratic counteroffensive and fight fire with fire? We either fight back NOW or we surrender our democracy forever.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wlUBxXrb2hNQweucp6MJz12PoaybV9AfdTZleXP09UgXfqrdx2Grxr2Em_8n5dHb_Imx-CVKYFbkXPbeEcpF-TDdJ-vDRPTL1AMQZ61D0ceIynaC2n84YPm7eT8quPJxJNlqtZC2xgF_pMFH1d_1trfZ5aVL734AxJlAbJLMJA4g90uX3IQrStXrZSob0B0FhwDsyi_xsc_YTF2qUYdP1JQG1la1kMaAwDJRbPhpvmU=&c=NggvktVpWUkJIsOEnUE2NBJpyy3ah5TLJgi8gFtFL_9tvIQys2YbPg==&ch=25l2pLdrn4MwxuFuqZlRrXlUcBPMNjTncFOmbozCUmctoGLQHYawkg==)

I was one of the officers who defended our nation's Capitol from Trump's rioters on January 6th. That's why I just testified before a Senate committee to keep them OUT of prestigious government positions in Maryland.
After Donald Trump PARDONED violent insurrectionists, they are infiltrating our government -- from school boards to the Department of Justice.
**I 'll be damned if I ever stop pushing back against the false narratives about that day. **I was immersed in a profane mix of sweat, screams, shrieks, anger, death, fear, blood, broken limbs, spit, hatred, horror, and bigotry.
These people do NOT belong in our government. But as long as Donald Trump holds a trifecta in Washington, he will keep attacking our institutions and keep propping up people who are out to END our democracy for good.
I never saw protecting our democracy as just another job -- it was my duty. When I get to Congress, I'll fight tooth and nail to defend our democracy and stop Trump's wannabe dictatorship.
**[But every moment counts in a campaign this competitive, and we're running out of time to hit our end-of-quarter goal and show MAGA mega-donors we have the numbers to win. Can you rush in a grassroots contribution of any amount right now to help us pull ahead?](https://substack.com/redirect/2e4038b2-af7f-4618-8d27-3cb475724b78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I will always raise my voice to support bills that defend our democracy -- like the one in Maryland that will stop violent insurrectionists from holding prestigious government positions.
No matter how many threats I get or how many MAGA mega-donors try to flood Maryland's 5th district with lies and attack ads, I will always speak up.

I wanted to reach out and thank you for your support and assistance with our campaign. As we try to restore true Democracy back into our politics and return our government to “We the People”, it is apparent that the established political parties only want our votes, but do not want our input, ideas or non-establishment candidates. Unfortunately, this campaign will not be on the ballot for the May Primary. We needed to obtain 1000 signatures in 20 days, and we fell about 200 short. I will mention that this is where we, as voters, need to get involved. We need to demand balanced rules from our political parties that are not designed to keep people out of the process, but rather encourage participation from everyday folks, not just political insiders. While it would be easy to dismiss these comments as sour grapes, the fact is only 2 out of 6 candidates who filed with the Federal Election Commission as Democratic candidates for this Congressional seat are going to be on the Primary ballot in May. Both of those candidates received help obtaining signatures from local Democratic committees. As a result, the approximate 700 local Democratic committee members were able to meet the 1000 signatures requirement in the mandated 20 days for those candidates they chose to support, all to the exclusion of the other candidates. In contrast, our campaign had 40 volunteers who worked hard to help secure the required signatures, but 20 days is a very limited timeframe. To put this in further perspective, had I lived in New Jersey and chose to run for U.S. Congress there, I would have needed 500 signatures to be on the Primary ballot and would have had from January 1st until March 23rd to obtain them. The simple truth is that Pennsylvania’s political parties, both Democrats and Republicans, do not want to weaken the power they possess. Each party’s committee members want to pre-select the candidates the voters will ultimately vote for, well before the voting public has turned its attention to the primary elections. I know this to be true because a Northampton Township Democrats committee member put it in writing**. In an email she stated, “I so understand your point on the purpose and value of primaries. I firmly believe that winning this particular race is so crucial to democracy that I am not willing to let the chips fall where they may.”** Let that sink in. The local committee people running our political parties are so arrogant that they are willing to openly say that their opinions about candidates are more important than those of the voters. As a result, voters only get the candidates who are part of the establishment political party. Which is why we continue to get uninspiring, ineffective candidates who never change all the things that are broken in our political system, because they are part of that same system. Although highly disappointing, I am very grateful for the efforts of everyone who got involved and tried to make a difference. I was genuinely moved by all the folks who supported this campaign. Thank you very much! Tracy

While it would be easy to dismiss these comments as sour grapes, the fact is only 2 out of 6 candidates who filed with the Federal Election Commission as Democratic candidates for this Congressional seat are going to be on the Primary ballot in May. Both of those candidates received help obtaining signatures from local Democratic committees. As a result, the approximate 700 local Democratic committee members were able to meet the 1000 signatures requirement in the mandated 20 days for those candidates they chose to support, all to the exclusion of the other candidates. In contrast, our campaign had 40 volunteers who worked hard to help secure the required signatures, but 20 days is a very limited timeframe. To put this in further perspective, had I lived in New Jersey and chose to run for U.S. Congress there, I would have needed 500 signatures to be on the Primary ballot and would have had from January 1st until March 23rd to obtain them. The simple truth is that Pennsylvania’s political parties, both Democrats and Republicans, do not want to weaken the power they possess. Each party’s committee members want to pre-select the candidates the voters will ultimately vote for, well before the voting public has turned its attention to the primary elections. I know this to be true because a Northampton Township Democrats committee member put it in writing. In an email she stated, “I so understand your point on the purpose and value of primaries. I firmly believe that winning this particular race is so crucial to democracy that I am not willing to let the chips fall where they may.” Let that sink in. The local committee people running our political parties are so arrogant that they are willing to openly say that their opinions about candidates are more important than those of the voters. As a result, voters only get the candidates who are part of the establishment political party. Which is why we continue to get uninspiring, ineffective candidates who never change all the things that are broken in our political system, because they are part of that same system. Although highly disappointing, I am very grateful for the efforts of everyone who got involved and tried to make a difference. I was genuinely moved by all the folks who supported this campaign. Thank you very much! Tracy | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Tracy Hunt for Congress You received this email because you signed up on our website or donated to the campaign.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | President Trump — a sweeping change that could forever alter retirement accounts, including millions of 401(k)s. # Exxon and Yamaha flee Blue States south
Yamaha Motor and Exxon Mobil are t**[he latest companies relocating from high-cost blue states](https://substack.com/redirect/a404facd-e102-4b39-bf98-1203858403c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to the Sun Belt, with Yamaha moving its HQ from California to Georgia and Exxon shifting registration from New Jersey to Texas to cut expenses and gain legal advantages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a404facd-e102-4b39-bf98-1203858403c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Yamaha Heads to Georgia** : After nearly 50 years in Cypress, California, Yamaha relocates HQ to Kennesaw starting late 2026, citing high operating costs and regulations, selling its campus by 2028.
* **Exxon Aligns in Texas** : Corporate registration moves from New Jersey to Texas to match Spring HQ, seeking stronger protections against activists and climate suits plus better policymaker ties.
* **Broader Sun Belt Trend Accelerates** : Firms chase lower taxes, cheaper wages, office space, and talent in states like Texas and Georgia, following population shifts from coastal hubs.
* **Cost Savings Drive Moves** : Examples show 15-20% lower expenses in Austin or Dallas versus California or New Jersey, with easier scaling and housing affordability luring workers.

# Hormuz vessel traffic trickles amid Iran blockade
Iran's effective blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has slashed tanker transits to just 21 since late February 2026, **[stranding thousands of seafarers and backing up nearly 400 vessels](https://substack.com/redirect/7de9435a-eceb-4977-a00c-75118f057560?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the Gulf of Oman amid the ongoing U.S.-Israel-Iran conflict, threatening global oil flows.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7de9435a-eceb-4977-a00c-75118f057560?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strait Traffic Plummets Sharply** : Only 21 tankers have passed through since the war's start on Feb. 28, down from over 100 daily pre-conflict, with Iran selectively allowing some non-Iranian oil cargoes via negotiations.
* **Vessels Face Major Backlogs** : Around 400 ships wait in the Gulf of Oman, many diverting to UAE and Oman ports like Fujairah and Sohar, causing regional congestion and stranding crews.
* **Attacks Target Diverse Ships** : At least 16 vessels hit in sporadic, seemingly random strikes near key areas, affecting international flags without clear pattern and sowing market confusion.
* **China-Iran Talks Enable Passages** : Some China-linked ships transit safely, with Iran continuing crude exports to China while Cosco and others pause Middle East bookings after incidents.

* * *
* * *
# Fed expected to hold rates steady amid Iran oil turmoil
The Federal Reserve is **[expected to keep interest rates unchanged](https://substack.com/redirect/591bf643-7530-491f-880c-526d1b841394?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at 3.5%-3.75% on March 18, 2026, for the second straight meeting, citing persistent inflation risks from Iran-driven oil market chaos, erratic job data, and a resilient economy despite mixed signals.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/591bf643-7530-491f-880c-526d1b841394?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **No Cuts Expected Soon** : Markets price near-zero chance of easing now, with futures pointing to possible cuts only by September-October and just one total in 2026 amid uncertainty.
* **Oil and Geopolitics Complicate Outlook** : Iran conflict **[spikes oil prices and inflation fears,](https://substack.com/redirect/6c0b72d3-08bc-4d89-85bb-d0feae93afe6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with core inflation sticky above 2% target for years, prompting a cautious "wait-and-see" stance.
* **Labor Market Shows Mixed Signals** : **[Erratic job numbers](https://substack.com/redirect/6c0b72d3-08bc-4d89-85bb-d0feae93afe6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** add to hesitation, while solid GDP and economic strength raise the bar for rate reductions despite some dissents.
* **Powell Focuses on Uncertainty** : Post-meeting statement likely emphasizes risks from Middle East tensions, potential inflation spikes, and balanced policy options if pressures persist.

# Costco launches fertility treatment discounts
Costco partners with Sesame and IVI RMA North America to **[offer members up to 80% off fertility medications and services](https://substack.com/redirect/b7ee0085-0359-44b6-997a-0a8f63c15418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** like IVF and egg freezing, addressing infertility costs that affect 1 in 6 Americans through coordinated telehealth and clinic care.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7ee0085-0359-44b6-997a-0a8f63c15418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Savings on Medications** : Discounts reach 80% on drugs like Follistim (normally ~$2,000 per cartridge), potentially saving thousands per IVF or treatment cycle for members.
* **Full Range Services Covered** : Program includes IVF, IUI, egg freezing, PGT-A testing, single embryo transfers, fertility preservation, and LGBTQ+ specialized care.
* **Telehealth and Clinic Integration** : Sesame handles evaluations and planning via telehealth; IVI RMA provides in-clinic procedures; Costco pharmacies dispense meds transparently.
* **Accessible Via Membership** : Available nationwide online at Sesame's site, requiring standard Costco membership to reduce barriers through affordable, coordinated fertility support.

* * *

# Investors hope they have seen the end of Iran War volatility
Investors are questioning if equities have bottomed after early war volatility,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/b4f34d03-771f-441d-8024-a0c6164d12f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[with the S&P 500 rebounding 1.3% this week](https://substack.com/redirect/b4f34d03-771f-441d-8024-a0c6164d12f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and down just 3.8% from January highs as oil fears ease and bearish bets unwind amid resilient earnings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b4f34d03-771f-441d-8024-a0c6164d12f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Market Shows Recovery Signs** : S&P up 1.3% weekly for best two-day stretch since conflict start, with VIX dropping from 35 peak to 22, signaling reduced panic.
* **Options Bets Shift Bullish** : Traders unwind bearish positions, with demand for downside protection subsiding from recent highs and limited VIX enthusiasm.
* **War Impacts Less Severe** : Losses stay below pullback levels despite oil surge concerns, supply chain risks, and AI/private credit worries, bolstered by earnings growth.
* **Resilience Amid Uncertainty** : CFRA strategist notes investor calm, with underlying earnings support preventing deeper spooks from geopolitical events.

* * *
* * *
# Josh D'Amaro takes on Disney CEO role
Longtime Disney executive Josh D'Amaro **[assumes CEO role on March 18, 2026, succeeding Bob Iger](https://substack.com/redirect/664ea96e-a1b7-4367-878f-4c20b1a793a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at the shareholder meeting, ushering in a new era focused on theme parks and streaming growth amid recent stock pressures.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/664ea96e-a1b7-4367-878f-4c20b1a793a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Leadership Transition Official** : D'Amaro, former Disney Experiences chairman, steps up after succession process, with Iger staying as advisor and board member until year-end retirement.
* **Core Growth Priorities Set** : Emphasis on sustaining theme park momentum, profitable streaming quarters, and expansions like Abu Dhabi parks following strong earnings drivers.
* **Recent Wins Bolster Outlook** : Disney topped 2025 box office with hits like Lilo & Stitch and Avatar, plus streaming profitability supporting the handoff.
* **Stock Faces Investor Scrutiny** : Shares down over 10% YTD, with Wall Street watching closely for execution on parks, streaming, and post-Iger strategy.

Friend,

For too many American families, affordable housing is out of reach.

Rents are rising. Housing supply is too low. And for millions of people, the American dream of finding a safe, affordable place to live feels further away than ever.

That’s why I’ve been working across the aisle to take real action.

Just this week, the Senate passed the **21st Century ROAD to Housing Act** with strong bipartisan support — the first comprehensive housing package passed in Congress in _decades._

I’m proud that **two of my bills** were included in that package to help expand housing supply and lower costs.

And I’m not stopping there.

I also introduced the **Rental Housing Investment Act** , legislation designed to lower construction costs and help build more rental homes that families can actually afford.

Because if we want to reduce the cost of housing, we need to **build more homes — and build them faster.**

Everyone deserves a safe, affordable place to live.

But solving America’s housing crisis will take sustained effort, and grassroots support helps make this work possible.

Our first **End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline of the year** is coming up in just a few weeks, and early support helps us build the resources needed to keep pushing solutions like this forward.

| Friends,
You're getting the **_INSIDE_ _SCOOP_** : This week I will file for re-election to the U.S. House of Representatives!
And before we file, I wanted to reach out to those who have been with me since the very beginning. Against all odds and the political pundits, WE WON because of people just like you who believed in our mission of healing our nation and put their time, money, and energy to see it through.
_And I'm asking for you to step up again and help me in our re-election efforts._
From securing our border and cutting government red tape, to standing up for Veterans, defending the Second Amendment, and championing American energy independence - we've gotten a lot done so far in my first term of office. And with President Trump’s endorsement, the momentum behind this campaign is stronger than ever.
But I know that campaigns aren't won in Washington - they're won right here at home with people like you. So as we prepare for re-election, I want to build our volunteer team up across the district bigger and stronger than ever, and we want you signed up with TEAM BIGGS.
**Even if you've signed up in the past, I'm asking you to click the link[HERE](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LKR1aS8hLy79hgJG6R/4toiS7YGRIpS) and add your name to our roster so I know I have your backing. **
No matter what you can do: hosting an event, donating to the campaign, making phone calls, knocking on doors, writing letters, posting on social media, and so much more - I promise you are needed!

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks -- Donald Trump’s allies want him to declare a national “emergency,” all so he can take control of our elections .
A draft executive order circulating among MAGA elites would let him federalize election oversight, seize voting machines, and override state and local officials ahead of the 2026 midterms. Under the false banner of “election integrity,” these extremists are laying the groundwork to control how — and whether — our votes are counted.
Congress cannot sit back and wait for this draft to become reality. Lawmakers must move now to block any executive order that would federalize or seize control of our elections and hold immediate hearings to expose this scheme.
Tell Congress: Stop Trump’s emergency power grab. Block any executive order that would federalize or seize control of our elections >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-emergency-plot-to-take-over-elections/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Trump tried to overturn the 2020 election after he lost. Now his movement is pushing him to attempt something even more dangerous: rewriting the rules before ballots are cast.
The backlash has been so fierce that Trump is now denying knowledge of the scheme. But we’ve seen this before. On the campaign trail, he claimed he knew nothing about the extreme Project 2025 agenda. Now that same blueprint is shaping his second term.
If a president can declare an “emergency” to seize election infrastructure, no election in America is safe . That’s why we need Congress to act immediately, before this plot goes any further.

Peter,

This page of the Riverside County Sheriff's "yearbook" was written by my employees. To be frank, their opinions and those of Riverside County residents are the only ones that truly matter to me on the topic of the summer 2020 riots.

[](https://links.biancoforgovernor.com/s/c/u-h9FTD2Uv0N4t7KbpFe8WjnVQbB59mLrIZep5NxXylgOeo_jIkhrNjYfEAxFAMd2-tIPYTYG3yZ2FtwZcjU7d0qmxc2xD-HzBWDTi8zX9_-N9MnxUmVhzK7ZW-BImLc19m6G0GvfM9ESvxjtSb9lIlubXXLo6pnHaWLPLLRNEPRQlSbuFMfOmHagLv8rpAKJ6lH05gsFSVZG69yVJ5naLzheY78I2tSOmzMKiEz7ptVuLF5FWCnN3_B4wBxdP2Z7UOXQPBu-i5Z6Wg9521L_4NG-RdMLbegtm7CHHPBUQWFtQeUMt6CTwUhaxAgl0FPHCh4gevGbkFaoVrnB0jYAJfGnOxhKlqqnADtYVLz-ehDAEh1BMPVDKxLIMGxIuZ9qEMVU5N7Z_sX4mB49eHbyzAoylWPnqRzNoMARmhxC-lfUBIF0ZCU1GpU5M20F4IowRrbH0VgK85N7GX0bSH866O9Dmw74SaJxcTEjGY8mLO-t3aKeEGVa4xobW9Rk4S5m9E_ujNAZT48yhifJJyHuWwSvfsm/WsJyP9jEN6DofhBBMAqW83EWCTTiAIa-/18)

Everyone who was there knows that we did everything in our power to honor the First Amendment rights of Riverside County protestors -- **while showing zero tolerance for agitators, rioters, and violence.**

My leadership and the actions of all law enforcement that day set the standard for responding to the protests. Compassion, empathy, and yes, **Prayer** , were our priorities. When all else failed, we showed overwhelming force, and the results speak for themselves:

• Multiple arrests
• No injuries
• No property damage or theft

**These types of protests have not returned to Riverside County and will never be tolerated here.**

If you are ready for a Governor who will bring this exact zero-tolerance, law-and-order approach to the rest of California, [please make a contribution to my campaign today. »](https://links.biancoforgovernor.com/s/c/H2S15l3jiXds79eOY-ufhrUqZhQtmUuHCGj6igdsRY25JKNK98DcMlcQf5W2Nhu5BhDEpFZ8tSanEHTifUT14UItpjo2MrLPP7RzNQ793mJwMwSalBYBX3NfaGBjYpbPu-wcmbTlWpjgmdYk-TvofJPXNW8YTlBGzCEiSWd7bO-mM10sjuZUY6C4vJqfQUk-th0nVGljUrapn7Fioe2DgW9Y2KjRIGolV86QjO04I6r_zxsSjOOyuh1mNLHcRjYhjWf2rQ4OGZ7jDCzTF2xbWpF4H2OzWENlgYZvqKE7UZeOTGm71Ae6wGDUOSXA_ffNfXM57QZrrZkfUD1sYoKV-gxNIkpwZOfI66rL-9ZXRY11K6kilylGWTTnRy0L60u7AMZ-4tqA3dIbZSlhPqtfQcToTLQQhvV43pv8GvnMT7c3V5ehNDyh06sjfRAJ6qf1-bJ5gs_uTR93m1ZOR9Xig0zhI4Oekm1xKQZIoffNb9kLuMDOZo1EJBeBb42Dub-igtfg0fmskXuR0131p1nrmvXs1FVH/4mAjKttDFHQzwnnP0Hxww1y2b4YXW8Gd/18)

The "Armchair Leaders" who lie about my record to raise money for their own ambitions do not care about the truth or about California. And they certainly don't know how to lead (because they never have).

Character, honesty, adherence to law, and selfless service, combined with my faith in God, will always rule my conduct.
